const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const publishGuard = function publishGuard(input) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const inp = input || {};
  const jobId = s(inp.jobId);
  const tenantId = s(inp.systemTenantId);
  const nonce = (s(inp.uuid).replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "").toLowerCase() + "000000000000000000000000").slice(0, 24);
  const bad = (why) => ({ route: "REJECT", jobId: "0", tenantId: "0", jobPrefixLike: "0|%", nonce: nonce, leaseOwner: "PUB|" + nonce, one: 1, result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: why, job_status: "", publish_route: "REJECT" });
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(jobId)) return bad("job_id: digits only");
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(tenantId)) return bad("no session tenant");
  return { route: "CONTINUE", jobId: jobId, tenantId: tenantId, jobPrefixLike: jobId + "|%", nonce: nonce, leaseOwner: "PUB|" + nonce, one: 1, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "", publish_route: "" };
};
const res = publishGuard({ jobId: [{{workflowparams:job_id}}][0], systemTenantId: [{{system:tenantId}}][0], uuid: [{{system:uuid}}][0] });
console.log("publish guard", JSON.stringify(res));
return res;

######## sql_node_Dr0E2zih [sql-node] Facts 1: the job (+ DB clock, lease flag, lease_until)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.plant_id,
       j.command,
       j.payload_hash,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.cancel_requested,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       j.line_count,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at,
       (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}

UNION ALL
SELECT 'OUTBOX' AS kind, CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(o.event_id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(o.dispatch_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(o.row_version AS CHAR) AS n, CAST(o.payload_hash AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(o.aggregate_id AS CHAR) AS y, CAST(o.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted

      const out = {};

const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const parsePrepared = function parsePrepared(rows, jobId, payloadHash) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r)[0] || null;
  let p = null;
  try {
    p = row ? JSON.parse(row.prepared_payload) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    p = null;
  }
  if (!p || s(p.job_id) !== s(jobId) || (payloadHash !== undefined && s(p.payload_hash) !== s(payloadHash)) || !Array.isArray(p.lines) || !p.header || !p.request) return null;
  return p;
};
const publishPre = function publishPre(guard, jobRows, stepRows, factRows, prepRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const jobs = (Array.isArray(jobRows) ? jobRows : jobRows ? [jobRows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const job = jobs.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const dbNow = jobs.length ? s(jobs[0].db_now) : "";
  const steps = {};
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(stepRows) ? stepRows : stepRows ? [stepRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))) steps[s(r.step_name)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.step_status), attempt: Number(r.attempt_count) || 0, opId: s(r.inventory_operation_id), ref: s(r.result_ref), code: s(r.error_code), message: s(r.error_message) };
  const facts = (Array.isArray(factRows) ? factRows : factRows ? [factRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const gdAll = facts.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id));
  const gd = gdAll.filter((r) => String(r.deleted) === "0");
  const gdDeleted = gdAll.filter((r) => String(r.deleted) !== "0");
  const lines = Number((facts.filter((r) => r.kind === "LINES")[0] || {}).n) || 0;
  const res = Number((facts.filter((r) => r.kind === "RES")[0] || {}).n) || 0;
  const outbox = facts.filter((r) => r.kind === "OUTBOX" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  const failedStep = Object.keys(steps).map((k) => steps[k]).filter((x) => x.status === "FAILED")[0] || null;
  const base = Object.assign(tailBase("REJECT"), { dbNow: dbNow, jobId: guard.jobId, organizationId: "0", plantId: "0", jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", rowVersion: job ? Number(job.row_version) || 0 : 0, operationId: "NONE", attempt: 1, gdId: "0", eventId: "GD_COMMITTED|0|1", deliveryNo: "NONE", tuplesSql: "(0,0)", soLineIdsSql: "0", soIdsSql: "0", steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone, opStatus: "", gdStatus: gd.length ? s(gd[0].v) : "", gdCount: gd.length, lineCount: lines, resCount: res, outboxStatus: outbox ? s(outbox.v) : "", needStepP0: "NO", leaseUntil: "", job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", plannedLineCount: 0, effectCount: 0, itemEffectCount: 0, allocationMode: "", packing: { required: 0, packing_mode: "", packing_no_type: "" }, soProjection: { lines: [], so_ids: [] }, request: {}, payloadHash: "", effectsHash: "", lineKeys: [], lineParents: {}, resKeys: [], eventInfo: { picking_required: 0, source_so_ids: [], line_count: 0 }, failedStep: "", failedCode: "", failedMessage: "" });
  const answer = (code, why) => Object.assign({}, base, { result_code: code, result_message: why });
  if (!job) return answer("GD_INVALID_DATA", "job " + guard.jobId + " not found in tenant " + guard.tenantId);
  if (String(job.is_deleted) !== "0") return answer("GD_INVALID_DATA", "job is deleted");
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  const org = s(job.organization_id);
  const plant = s(job.plant_id);
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(org) || !/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(plant)) return answer("GD_INVALID_DATA", "job organization_id / plant_id are not ids");
  if (["READY_TO_COMMIT", "COMMITTING_GD"].indexOf(status) < 0) return answer(["GD_COMMITTED", "COMPLETED", "CREATING_PICKING", "PICKING_READY", "PICKING_RETRYING"].indexOf(status) >= 0 ? "" : "JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION", "job is " + status + ": GD_BULK_COMMIT works on READY_TO_COMMIT / COMMITTING_GD only");
  const rv = Number(job.row_version) || 0;
  const jobRow = { id: s(job.id), job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", progress_percent: Math.max(Number(job.progress_percent) || 0, GDC.progress.COMMITTING_GD), progress_message: GDC.display.COMMITTING_GD, attempt_count: Number(job.attempt_count) || 0, next_attempt_at: job.next_attempt_at || null, lease_owner: guard.leaseOwner, lease_expires_at: s(job.lease_until), row_version: rv + 1, error_code: job.error_code || null, error_message: job.error_message || null, error_details: job.error_details || null, gd_id: job.gd_id || null, gd_no: job.gd_no || null, started_at: job.started_at || dbNow, gd_committed_at: null, finished_at: null };
  if (String(job.cancel_requested) === "1" && status === "READY_TO_COMMIT") return Object.assign({}, base, { route: "CANCEL", publish_route: "CANCEL", organizationId: org, plantId: plant, jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobRow, { job_status: "CANCELLED", progress_message: GDC.display.CANCELLED, lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: dbNow })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_message: "cancelled before publishing", job_status: "CANCELLED" });
  // a SPLIT| lease (publishP2Split) is a hand-over to the next GD_BULK_COMMIT run, not a foreign holder (fix round 4)
  if (status === "COMMITTING_GD" && s(job.lease_owner) && s(job.lease_owner) !== guard.leaseOwner && s(job.lease_owner).indexOf("SPLIT|") !== 0 && String(job.lease_live) === "1") return answer("JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT", "job lease is held by " + s(job.lease_owner) + " until " + s(job.lease_expires_at));
  if (status === "COMMITTING_GD" && String(job.due) === "0") return answer("", "job is not due before " + s(job.next_attempt_at) + " (backoff)");
  const prepared = parsePrepared(prepRows, guard.jobId, job.payload_hash);
  if (!prepared) return answer("PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID", "prepared_payload is missing, or is not this job's prepared payload for its payload_hash");
  const p3 = steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const attempt = p3 && p3.attempt > 0 ? p3.attempt : 1;
  const operationId = p3 && p3.opId ? p3.opId : (org === "0" ? "TEST|GD|" : "GD|") + guard.jobId + "|" + attempt;
  const gdId = gd.length === 1 ? s(gd[0].id) : s(job.gd_id);
  const okId = /^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(gdId) ? gdId : "0";

  // node is one goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub row with its own job_line_key

  for (const l of prepared.lines) {
    storedLines.push(l);
    if (l && Array.isArray(l.children)) for (const c of l.children) storedLines.push(c);
  }

    plantId: plant,
    rowVersion: rv,

    effectsHash: s(prepared.effects_hash),

    // the item bundle structure P1 check verifies (key -> the bundle row's key; top-level rows have none)
    lineParents: storedLines.reduce((o, l) => {
      if (l && Array.isArray(l.children)) for (const c of l.children) o[s(c.job_line_key)] = s(l.job_line_key);
      return o;
    }, {}),
    resKeys: (prepared.reservations || []).map((r) => s(r.job_line_key)),
    eventInfo: prepared.event || { picking_required: 1, source_so_ids: [], line_count: storedLines.length },
    jobRows: [jobRow],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
    leaseUntil: s(job.lease_until),
    job_status: status,
  });
  // a clean failure decided earlier (a FAILED step row, or a deleted marker header with no live one) is finished, never re-run
  if (status === "COMMITTING_GD" && (failedStep || (!gd.length && gdDeleted.length))) {
    const code = failedStep ? failedStep.code || "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED" : "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED";

GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson({ step: failedStep ?   }
  return Object.assign(out, {
    route: "CONTINUE",
    publish_route: "CONTINUE",
    stepAddRows: steps.P0_REVALIDATE ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: org, step_name: "P0_REVALIDATE", step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }],

function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

  const lines = live(gdRows, "LINE").concat(live(gdRows, "LINEX"));
  const resRows = live(structRows, "RES");
  const packs = live(structRows, "PACK");

"YES" : "NO", hasLines: lines.length ? "YES" : "NO", hasRes: resRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", hasPack: packs.length ? "YES" : "NO" });

// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

######## sql_node_zAnsO20L [sql-node] Read-back: job, steps, header, operation, outbox
SELECT 'JOB' AS kind, CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(j.error_code AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(j.job_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(j.row_version AS CHAR) AS n, CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(j.lease_owner AS CHAR) AS y, CAST(j.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GD' AS kind, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, '' AS x, '' AS y, CAST(g.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}')
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OP' AS kind, CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(o.operation_id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(o.operation_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, CAST(o.result_code AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(o.review_reference AS CHAR) AS y, CAST(o.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM inventory_operation o
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o.operation_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
RESP: ['kind', 'id', 'k', 'v', 'n', 'x', 'y', 'deleted']

######## sql_node_uGDRA3dm [sql-node] P0: the item_balance rows of the reservations' (material, bin) tuples, read-only
SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,

######## code_node_MgeRWMzD [code-node] P0 REVALIDATE: lease ours + job COMMITTING_GD + one balance row per tuple -> P0 DONE; a lost lease -> REJECT (carried, nothing written)
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P0 REVALIDATE: the lease is ours, the job COMMITTING_GD, one balance row per tuple (read-only) -> P0 DONE
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const publishP0 = function publishP0(guard, pre, jobRows, balRows, stepRows, soRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const D = dec8();
  const job = (Array.isArray(jobRows) ? jobRows : [jobRows]).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const steps = {};
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(stepRows) ? stepRows : [stepRows]).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))) steps[s(r.step_name)] = r;
  const reject = (code, why) => Object.assign(tailBase("REJECT"), { result_code: code, result_message: why, job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "" });
  if (!job) return reject("GD_INVALID_DATA", "job vanished after the lease claim");
  if (s(job.lease_owner) !== guard.leaseOwner) return reject("JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT", "lease claim lost: owner is " + s(job.lease_owner));
  if (s(job.job_status) !== "COMMITTING_GD") return reject("JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION", "job is " + s(job.job_status) + " after the claim");
  const p0 = steps.P0_REVALIDATE;
  if (!p0) return reject("GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "P0_REVALIDATE step row missing after its insert");
  if (s(p0.step_status) === "DONE") return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { result_message: "P0 already DONE" });
  const need = {};
  for (const t of String(pre.tuplesSql).replace(/^\(|\)$/g, "").split("),(")) if (t && t !== "0,0") need[t] = true;
  const have = {};
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(balRows) ? balRows : [balRows]).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))) {
    const k = s(r.material_id) + "," + s(r.location_id);
    have[k] = (have[k] || []).concat([r]);
  }
  const problems = [];
  for (const k of Object.keys(need)) {
    const rows = have[k] || [];
    if (rows.length !== 1) problems.push(k + ": " + rows.length + " balance rows");
    else if (D.parse(rows[0].unrestricted_qty) === null) problems.push(k + ": unreadable balance");
  }
  const so = (Array.isArray(soRows) ? soRows : soRows ? [soRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) && s(r.id));
  const sol = {};
  for (const r of so.filter((r) => r.kind === "SOL")) sol[s(r.id)] = r;
  const hid = {};
  for (const r of so.filter((r) => r.kind === "HID")) hid[s(r.id)] = D.parse(r.n) || 0n;
  let code = "GD_STOCK_CHANGED";
  for (const l of (pre.soProjection || {}).lines || []) {
    const r = sol[s(l.so_line_id)];
    if (!r) {
      problems.push("sales order line " + s(l.so_line_id) + " vanished");
      continue;
    }
    const committed = (D.parse(r.x) || 0n) + (D.parse(r.n) || 0n) + (hid[s(l.so_line_id)] || 0n) + (D.parse(l.delta) || 0n);
    if (committed > (D.parse(l.limit) || 0n)) {
      code = "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY";
      problems.push("sales order line " + s(l.so_line_id) + ": delivered + planned + processing + this delivery " + D.fmt(committed) + " > " + l.limit);
    }
  }
  if (problems.length) {
    const preSteps = Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: Object.assign({}, pre.steps, { P0_REVALIDATE: { id: s(p0.id), status: s(p0.step_status), attempt: Number(p0.attempt_count) || 1, opId: "" } }) });
    return failClean(guard, preSteps, "P0_REVALIDATE", code, "P0 revalidation: " + problems.slice(0, 5).join("; "), {}, { problems: problems });
  }
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { stepDoneRows: [{ id: s(p0.id), step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: Number(p0.attempt_count) || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], needStepUpd: "YES" });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep(null, {}, () => publishP0(guard, pre, [{{node:sql_node_osegb8TO.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_uGDRA3dm.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_GvvtDPr2.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_Acs6w1I0.data}}][0]));
console.log("publish P0", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, result: res.result_code, message: res.result_message }));
return res;

RESP: ['route', 'publish_route', 'result_code', 'result_message', 'job_status', 'jobRows', 'needJobUpd', 'stepDoneRows', 'needStepUpd', 'stepAddRows', 'needStepAdd', 'headerIds', 'lineIds', 'resIds', 'packIds', 'hasHeader', 'hasLines', 'hasRes', 'hasPack', 'tEnd', 'tRoute', 'tResultCode', 'tResultMessage', 'tJobStatus', 'tJobRows', 'tNeedJobUpd', 'tStepDoneRows', 'tNeedStepUpd', 'tStepAddRows', 'tNeedStepAdd', 'tHeaderIds', 'tLineIds', 'tResIds', 'tPackIds', 'tHasHeader', 'tHasLines', 'tHasRes', 'tHasPack', 'tail']

######## sql_node_Tt1hn1xZ [sql-node] The inventory operation by operation_id (+ gate, lease flag): from here on every check knows whether the operation may have run (C1: nothing is failed cleanly once it may have)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.operation_id,
       o.operation_status,
       o.result_code,
       o.review_reference,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.mutation_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS mutation_started_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS lease_expires_at,
       (o.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken,
       g.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner,
       CAST(st.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       st.step_status AS p3_status,
       st.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       st.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN inventory_operation o
    ON o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'

######## code_node_KBrubvGI [code-node] P1 plan: hidden header + lines only when no header carries JOB|<job> and no row carries this delivery_no
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P1 plan: the hidden header (+ table_gd lines, from the prepared payload) only when no header carries this job's marker and no row carries this delivery_no (read immediately before)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const parsePrepared = function parsePrepared(rows, jobId, payloadHash) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r)[0] || null;
  let p = null;
  try {
    p = row ? JSON.parse(row.prepared_payload) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    p = null;
  }
  if (!p || s(p.job_id) !== s(jobId) || (payloadHash !== undefined && s(p.payload_hash) !== s(payloadHash)) || !Array.isArray(p.lines) || !p.header || !p.request) return null;
  return p;
};
const publishP1Plan = function publishP1Plan(guard, pre0, prepRows, gdRows, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, gdRows), opRows);
  const rows = (Array.isArray(gdRows) ? gdRows : gdRows ? [gdRows] : []).filter((r) => r && r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id));
  const marker = "JOB|" + guard.jobId;
  const mine = rows.filter((r) => s(r.y) === marker);
  // OI4: a delivery numbered on insert ("issued") has no number another row could hold - only the marker counts
  const others = pre.deliveryNo === "issued" ? [] : rows.filter((r) => s(r.y) !== marker);
  const st = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P1_GD_HEADER", "");
  const empty = { needHeader: "NO", headerRows: [] };
  if (others.length) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P1_GD_HEADER", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "document number " + pre.deliveryNo + " is already used by another delivery (" + s(others[0].k) + ", " + (String(others[0].deleted) === "0" ? "live" : "deleted") + ")", {}), empty);
  if (mine.length && mine.every((r) => String(r.deleted) !== "0")) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P1_GD_HEADER", "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "the hidden delivery was soft-deleted by an earlier clean failure", {}), empty);
  const skip = pre.stepsDone.P1_GD_HEADER === "YES" || mine.length > 0;
  if (skip) return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO" });
  const p = parsePrepared(prepRows, guard.jobId);
  if (!p) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P1_GD_HEADER", "PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID", "prepared_payload unreadable at P1", {}), empty);
  const h = {};
  for (const k of GDC.header_fields) h[k] = p.header[k] === undefined ? null : p.header[k];
  // delivery_no is an engine-numbered field: -9999 ("Manual Input") keeps a concrete number as prepare checked it; a
  // rule id would make the add-node issue another number (engine fact F36, the same as item.material_code). OI4
  // (2026-10-02): "issued" + the rule id is the frozen save's own way - the add-node numbers the header by the rule,
  // P1 check reads the number back, and the reservation rows (P2) and movements (P3) carry it.
  h.delivery_no_type = s(p.header.delivery_no) === "issued" ? s(p.header.delivery_no_type) : "-9999";
  h.gd_status = GDC.gd_hidden;
  h.gd_dockey = marker;
  h.table_gd = p.lines;
  // gd_total as the frozen save computes it (code_node_IyJHrBst): top-level rows only, a bundle row carries the total
  let gdTotal = 0;
  for (const row of p.lines || []) {
    const oq = parseFloat(row && row.gd_order_quantity) || 0;
    const gq = parseFloat(row && row.gd_qty) || 0;
    if (oq > 0 && gq > 0) gdTotal += ((parseFloat(row.total_price) || 0) / oq) * gq;
  }
  h.gd_total = gdTotal.toFixed(8);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { needHeader: "YES", headerRows: [h], stepAddRows: st.rows, needStepAdd: st.need });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_MgeRWMzD.data.tail}}][0], { needHeader: "NO", headerRows: [] }, () => publishP1Plan(guard, pre, [{{node:sql_node_hSfouTOr.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_avZOXVA8.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_Tt1hn1xZ.data}}][0]));
console.log("publish P1 plan", JSON.stringify({ needHeader: res.needHeader, needStepAdd: res.needStepAdd }));
return res;

######## code_node_3n1ATbZu [code-node] P1 check: one header, every line once -> gd_id / gd_no, P1 DONE
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P1 check: one hidden header, every planned line present once -> gd_id / gd_no, P1 DONE
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"gd_hidden":"Processing","gd_published":"Created","so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP1Check = function publishP1Check(guard, pre0, rows, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, rows), opRows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const heads = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted) === "0");
  const lines = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "LINE" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted) === "0");
  // review fix round 1, M-3: live rows under this job's hidden header WITHOUT its job_line_key (an engine that dropped
  // the key, e.g. on a bundle's nested items): never planned, so a failure; a clean failure soft-deletes them as well
  const keyless = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "LINEX" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted) === "0" && heads.some((h) => s(h.id) === s(r.v)));
  const clean = () => ({ headerIds: heads.map((h) => ({ id: s(h.id), is_deleted: 1 })), lineIds: lines.concat(keyless).map((l) => ({ id: s(l.id), is_deleted: 1 })), resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: heads.length ? "YES" : "NO", hasLines: lines.length + keyless.length ? "YES" : "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const fail = (why) => Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P1_GD_HEADER", "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", why, clean()), { gdId: "0", gdNo: "", eventId: "GD_COMMITTED|0|1", lineIdByKey: {} });
  if (heads.length !== 1) return fail(heads.length ? heads.length + " hidden headers carry marker JOB|" + guard.jobId : "the hidden header was not written");
  const head = heads[0];
  const gdStatus = s(head.v);
  if ([GDC.gd_hidden, GDC.gd_published].indexOf(gdStatus) < 0) return fail("hidden header is " + gdStatus);
  if (keyless.length) return fail(keyless.length + " line rows under the hidden header carry no job_line_key of this job (first " + s(keyless[0].id) + ")");
  const byKey = {};
  for (const l of lines) {
    const k = s(l.k);
    if (byKey[k]) return fail("line " + k + " exists twice");
    byKey[k] = s(l.id);
  }
  const missing = (pre.lineKeys || []).filter((k) => !byKey[k]);
  if (missing.length) return fail(missing.length + " of " + pre.lineKeys.length + " lines are missing (first " + missing[0] + ")");
  if (Object.keys(byKey).length !== (pre.lineKeys || []).length) return fail("more line rows than planned: " + Object.keys(byKey).length);
  // item bundles (B-5, the first dev run is the engine proof): the tree must be stored as the old save's is - each item
  // with parent_id = its bundle row's id, every other row with none. A tree stored flat, or an item under the wrong row,
  // is a clean failure here, before any reservation or stock write (the soft-delete covers the items: they carry
  // job_line_key like every line).
  const parents = pre.lineParents || {};
  const parentOf = {};
  for (const l of lines) parentOf[s(l.k)] = s(l.y) === "0" ? "" : s(l.y);
  const badTree = [];
  for (const k of Object.keys(byKey)) {
    const want = parents[k] ? byKey[parents[k]] || "?" : "";
    if (parentOf[k] !== want) badTree.push(k + " has parent_id " + (parentOf[k] || "NULL") + ", expected " + (want || "NULL"));
  }
  if (badTree.length) return fail("item bundle lines were not stored under their bundle row: " + badTree.length + " of " + Object.keys(byKey).length + " rows (first: " + badTree[0] + ")");
  const gdId = s(head.id);
  const gdNo = s(head.k);
  if (!gdNo || gdNo === "issued") return fail("the hidden header has no document number (" + (gdNo || "empty") + "): the numbering rule did not assign one");
  const p1 = pre.steps.P1_GD_HEADER;
  const stepDoneRows = p1 && p1.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: p1.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: p1.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: gdId, error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
  const jobRows = s(pre.jobRows[0].gd_id) === gdId && s(pre.jobRows[0].gd_no) === gdNo ? [] : [Object.assign({}, pre.jobRows[0], { gd_id: gdId, gd_no: gdNo, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 2 })];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), clean(), { gdId: gdId, gdNo: gdNo, eventId: "GD_COMMITTED|" + gdId + "|1", jobRows: jobRows, needJobUpd: jobRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepDoneRows: stepDoneRows, needStepUpd: stepDoneRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", lineIdByKey: byKey });
};

       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,

    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}

######## code_node_XOMbyKcx [code-node] Job lease renewal (BEFORE_P2): still COMMITTING_GD under this run's lease -> lease_expires_at = NOW + 10 min
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - job lease renewal jr1 (BEFORE_P2): the job lease = NOW + 10 min while this run holds it (a chain node: nothing after a decided ending)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const publishJobLease = function publishJobLease(guard, rows, stage) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const r = list[0] || {};
  if (!s(r.db_now) || !s(r.lease_until)) throw new Error("GD_PUBLISH_READ: the lease read returned no DB time");
  const ours = s(r.id) !== "" && s(r.id) === s(guard.jobId) && s(r.lease_owner) === s(guard.leaseOwner) && s(r.lease_owner) !== "";
  const renew = ours && s(r.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), {
    stage: String(stage),
    dbNow: s(r.db_now),
    leaseUntil: s(r.lease_until),
    needLease: renew ? "YES" : "NO",
    leaseRows: renew ? [{ id: s(r.id), lease_expires_at: s(r.lease_until) }] : [],
    why: renew ? "job lease renewed until " + s(r.lease_until) : !s(r.id) ? "no job row" : !ours ? "the job's lease owner is " + (s(r.lease_owner) || "(none)") + ", not this run" : "job is " + s(r.job_status) + ": nothing to renew",
  });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];

console.log("job lease jr1", JSON.stringify({ stage: res.stage, renew: res.needLease, until: res.leaseUntil, why: res.why }));
return res;

######## code_node_JvwJVYCY [code-node] P2 plan: the missing reservation rows (bodies from the prepared payload) and the packing shell; the P2 step row
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P2 plan: the reservation rows still missing (by job_line_key, from the structure read immediately before; bodies from the prepared payload) and the packing shell when required; the P2 step row
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION","pack_hidden":"Processing"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const parsePrepared = function parsePrepared(rows, jobId, payloadHash) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r)[0] || null;
  let p = null;
  try {
    p = row ? JSON.parse(row.prepared_payload) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    p = null;
  }
  if (!p || s(p.job_id) !== s(jobId) || (payloadHash !== undefined && s(p.payload_hash) !== s(payloadHash)) || !Array.isArray(p.lines) || !p.header || !p.request) return null;
  return p;
};
const publishP2Plan = function publishP2Plan(guard, pre0, p1, prepRows, structRows, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, structRows), opRows);
  const struct = (Array.isArray(structRows) ? structRows : structRows ? [structRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted) === "0");
  const empty = { resAddRows: [], needResAdd: "NO", packAddRows: [], needPackAdd: "NO" };
  const p2Done = pre.stepsDone.P2_GD_STRUCTURE === "YES";
  if (p2Done) return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty);
  const have = {};
  for (const r of struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "RES")) have[s(r.k)] = true;
  const packs = struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "PACK");
  const p = parsePrepared(prepRows, guard.jobId);
  if (!p) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P2_GD_STRUCTURE", "PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID", "prepared_payload unreadable at P2", { headerIds: p1.headerIds, lineIds: p1.lineIds, hasHeader: p1.hasHeader, hasLines: p1.hasLines }), empty);
  const resAddRows = (p.reservations || []).filter((r) => !have[r.job_line_key]).map((r) => {
    const o = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(r)) if (k !== "stable_line_key" && k !== "allocation_sequence") o[k] = r[k];
    o.doc_id = p1.gdId;
    o.target_gd_id = p1.gdId;
    // OI4: numbered on insert - the number the P1 read-back found
    if (s(o.doc_no) === "issued") o.doc_no = p1.gdNo;
    o.doc_line_id = p1.lineIdByKey[guard.jobId + "|" + r.stable_line_key + "|0"] || "";
    return o;
  });
  const pk = pre.packing || { required: 0 };
  const packAddRows = pk.required && !packs.length ? [{ packing_status: GDC.pack_hidden, plant_id: pre.plantId, packing_no: "issued", packing_no_type: s(pk.packing_no_type), so_id: Array.isArray(p.header.so_id) ? p.header.so_id : [], so_no: s(p.header.so_no), gd_id: p1.gdId, gd_no: p1.gdNo, customer_id: [s(p.header.customer_name)], organization_id: pre.organizationId, packing_mode: s(pk.packing_mode), created_at: pre.dbNow, created_by: s(pre.request.requested_by), idempotency_key: "PKG|" + p1.gdId, table_item_source: [], table_hu_source: [] }] : [];
  const st = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P2_GD_STRUCTURE", "");
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { resAddRows: resAddRows, needResAdd: resAddRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", packAddRows: packAddRows, needPackAdd: packAddRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: st.rows, needStepAdd: st.need });
};

return res;

######## code_node_9esF8njJ [code-node] Batches of resAdd: one loop pass per <= 250 rows of p2Plan.resAddRows
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - batch list of resAdd (O4 option b): the slices of p2Plan.resAddRows, <= 250 rows each
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};
const res = writeBatches([{{node:code_node_JvwJVYCY.data.resAddRows}}][0], 250);
console.log("batches resAdd", JSON.stringify({ count: res.count, total: res.total }));
return res;

const writeBatchPick = function writeBatchPick(rows, indexRaw, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const index = indexRaw === undefined || indexRaw === null || indexRaw === "" ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseInt(String(indexRaw), 10) || 0);
  const part = list.slice(index * n, (index + 1) * n);
  return { rows: part, index: index, nextIndex: index + 1, count: part.length, from: index * n };
};
