######## code_node_HGbnLhvZ [code-node] P2 check: every reservation row once -> stage gd_line_id, P2 DONE, the P3 row
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P2 check: every reservation row present once and pointing at the hidden delivery -> stage rows' gd_line_id, P2 DONE, the P3 step row
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION","res_hidden":"Processing","res_published":"Allocated","pack_hidden":"Processing","pack_published":"Created"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP2Check = function publishP2Check(guard, pre0, p1, structRows, stageRows, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, structRows), opRows);
  const struct = (Array.isArray(structRows) ? structRows : structRows ? [structRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted) === "0");
  const live = struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "RES");
  const packs = struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "PACK");
  const clean = { headerIds: p1.headerIds, lineIds: p1.lineIds, resIds: live.map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), is_deleted: 1 })), packIds: packs.map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), is_deleted: 1 })), hasHeader: p1.hasHeader, hasLines: p1.hasLines, hasRes: live.length ? "YES" : "NO", hasPack: packs.length ? "YES" : "NO" };
  const fail = (why) => Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P2_GD_STRUCTURE", "GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", why, clean), { stageUpdRows: [], needStageUpd: "NO", resRows: [], packId: "", stepRows: struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "STEP") });
  const byKey = {};
  for (const r of live) {
    const k = s(r.k);
    if (byKey[k]) return fail("reservation row " + k + " exists twice");
    byKey[k] = r;
  }
  const missing = (pre.resKeys || []).filter((k) => !byKey[k]);
  if (missing.length) return fail(missing.length + " reservation rows missing (first " + missing[0] + ")");
  if (live.length !== (pre.resKeys || []).length) return fail("more reservation rows than planned: " + live.length);
  for (const r of live) {
    if (s(r.x) !== p1.gdId) return fail("reservation row " + s(r.k) + " points at another delivery");
    if ([GDC.res_hidden, GDC.res_published].indexOf(s(r.v)) < 0) return fail("reservation row " + s(r.k) + " is " + s(r.v));
  }
  const pk = pre.packing || { required: 0 };
  if (pk.required && packs.length !== 1) return fail(packs.length ? packs.length + " packing shells carry PKG|" + p1.gdId : "the packing shell was not written");
  if (!pk.required && packs.length) return fail("a packing shell exists although packing is not required");
  if (packs.length && [GDC.pack_hidden, GDC.pack_published].indexOf(s(packs[0].v)) < 0) return fail("packing shell is " + s(packs[0].v));
  const stageUpdRows = [];
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(stageRows) ? stageRows : stageRows ? [stageRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))) {
    const lineId = p1.lineIdByKey[guard.jobId + "|" + s(r.stable_line_key) + "|0"] || "";
    if (lineId && s(r.gd_line_id) !== lineId) stageUpdRows.push({ id: s(r.id), gd_line_id: lineId });
  }
  const p2 = pre.steps.P2_GD_STRUCTURE;
  const stepDoneRows = p2 && p2.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: p2.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: p2.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: live.length + " reservations, " + packs.length + " packing", error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
  const st = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", pre.operationId);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), clean, { stepDoneRows: stepDoneRows, needStepUpd: stepDoneRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stageUpdRows: stageUpdRows, needStageUpd: stageUpdRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: st.rows, needStepAdd: st.need, resRows: live.map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), job_line_key: s(r.k), reserved_qty: s(r.n) })), packId: packs.length ? s(packs[0].id) : "", stepRows: struct.filter((r) => r.kind === "STEP") });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const p1 = [{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_JvwJVYCY.data.tail}}][0], { stageUpdRows: [], needStageUpd: "NO", resRows: [], packId: "", stepRows: [] }, () => publishP2Check(guard, pre, p1, [{{node:sql_node_vrt3iLbY.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_j8dnqMTc.data}}][0], [{{node:sql_node_Tt1hn1xZ.data}}][0]));
console.log("publish P2 check", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, stageUpd: res.stageUpdRows.length, result: res.result_message }));
return res;

const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

######## code_node_NKccNgfL [code-node] P2 split: this run wrote the hidden structure -> SPLIT (handed over under a live SPLIT| lease; P3 in the next run); a resume run -> continue
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P2 split: this run wrote the hidden structure -> end here (handed over under a live SPLIT| lease); P3 and the publish steps run in the next GD_BULK_COMMIT run
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"display":{"QUEUED":"Queued for processing","VALIDATING":"Validating","AWAITING_CONFIRMATION":"Conditions changed; confirmation needed","CALCULATING":"Checking stock and allocation","READY_TO_COMMIT":"Ready to publish","COMMITTING_GD":"Publishing Goods Delivery","RECONCILING_GD":"GD {gd_no} created; finishing publication","GD_COMMITTED":"GD {gd_no} created","CREATING_PICKING":"GD {gd_no} created; creating Picking","PICKING_RETRYING":"GD {gd_no} created; Picking retrying","PICKING_READY":"GD {gd_no} created; Picking {picking_no} ready","COMPLETED":"GD {gd_no} created; processing complete","FAILED":"Not created; correct the highlighted lines","CANCELLED":"Cancelled before publishing","REQUIRES_REVIEW":"Under review (ref {review_reference}); do not retry"}};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};

######## code_node_z32qicpP [code-node] Job lease renewal (BEFORE_P3_CALL): still COMMITTING_GD under this run's lease -> lease_expires_at = NOW + 10 min
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - job lease renewal jr2 (BEFORE_P3_CALL): the job lease = NOW + 10 min while this run holds it (a chain node: nothing after a decided ending)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const publishJobLease = function publishJobLease(guard, rows, stage) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const r = list[0] || {};
  if (!s(r.db_now) || !s(r.lease_until)) throw new Error("GD_PUBLISH_READ: the lease read returned no DB time");
  const ours = s(r.id) !== "" && s(r.id) === s(guard.jobId) && s(r.lease_owner) === s(guard.leaseOwner) && s(r.lease_owner) !== "";
  const renew = ours && s(r.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), {
    stage: String(stage),
    dbNow: s(r.db_now),
    leaseUntil: s(r.lease_until),
    needLease: renew ? "YES" : "NO",
    leaseRows: renew ? [{ id: s(r.id), lease_expires_at: s(r.lease_until) }] : [],
    why: renew ? "job lease renewed until " + s(r.lease_until) : !s(r.id) ? "no job row" : !ours ? "the job's lease owner is " + (s(r.lease_owner) || "(none)") + ", not this run" : "job is " + s(r.job_status) + ": nothing to renew",
  });
};

const sha256Hex = function sha256Hex(text) {
  const s = String(text);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
      const d = i + 1 < s.length ? s.charCodeAt(i + 1) : 0;
      if (d >= 0xdc00 && d <= 0xdfff) {
        c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (d - 0xdc00);
        i++;
      } else c = 0xfffd;
    } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff) c = 0xfffd;
    if (c < 0x80) bytes.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) bytes.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else if (c < 0x10000) bytes.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else bytes.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
  }
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  const lo = bitLen >>> 0;
  bytes.push((hi >>> 24) & 255, (hi >>> 16) & 255, (hi >>> 8) & 255, hi & 255, (lo >>> 24) & 255, (lo >>> 16) & 255, (lo >>> 8) & 255, lo & 255);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const W = new Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += 64) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = ((bytes[off + 4 * t] << 24) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 1] << 16) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 2] << 8) | bytes[off + 4 * t + 3]) >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(W[t - 15], 7) ^ rotr(W[t - 15], 18) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(W[t - 2], 17) ^ rotr(W[t - 2], 19) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const mj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + mj) >>> 0;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
    H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
    H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
    H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
    H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
    H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
    H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
  }
  return H.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
};
const BALANCE_TYPES = CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_type").values;

const RESULT_CODES = CONTRACT.result_codes;

const MUTATION_STARTED = CONTRACT.operation.mutation_started;
const DECISIONS = Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(CONTRACT.repeat_decision.decisions.map((d) => [d, d])));
const BALANCE_KEY_RE = new RegExp(CONTRACT.request.effect_fields.find((f) => f.name === "balance_key").pattern);
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
const SCALE = 8;
const DECIMAL_RE = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,8}))?$/;
function canonicalQuantity(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" && typeof value !== "string") return null;
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  const m = String(value).trim().match(DECIMAL_RE);
  if (!m) return null;
  const units = toUnits(m[1], m[2] || "");
  return units > 0n ? fromUnits(units) : null;
}
function toUnits(intPart, fracPart) {
  return BigInt(intPart) * 10n ** BigInt(SCALE) + BigInt((fracPart || "").padEnd(SCALE, "0") || "0");
}
function quantityUnits(canonical) {
  const [i, f = ""] = canonical.split(".");
  return toUnits(i, f);
}
function fromUnits(units) {
  const base = 10n ** BigInt(SCALE);
  const i = units / base;
  const f = (units % base).toString().padStart(SCALE, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
  return f ? `${i}.${f}` : `${i}`;
}
function isBlank(v) {
  return v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() === "");
}
function validateEffect(effect, index) {
  const errors = [];
  const fail = (code, field) => errors.push({ code, field, index });
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = effect ? effect[f.name] : undefined;
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) {
      fail(f.name === "quantity_base" ? "QUANTITY_INVALID" : "REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
      continue;
    }
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    if (f.max_length && typeof v === "string" && v.length > f.max_length) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", f.name);
  }
  if (!effect) return errors;
  if (!isBlank(effect.effect_key) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(effect.effect_key))) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "effect_key");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_type) && !BALANCE_TYPES.includes(effect.balance_type)) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_type");
  if (!isBlank(effect.balance_key)) {
    const bk = String(effect.balance_key);
    if (!/^(ITEM|BATCH|HU|RESERVATION)\|/.test(bk) || bk.split("|")[0] !== effect.balance_type) fail("BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID", "balance_key");
    // The lock SQL interpolates balance keys as text (SQL nodes bind nothing, F10/F22):
    // only these characters are ever accepted.
    else if (!BALANCE_KEY_RE.test(bk)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "balance_key");
  }
  if (!isBlank(effect.direction) && !DIRECTIONS.includes(effect.direction)) fail("DIRECTION_INVALID", "direction");
  if (!isBlank(effect.quantity_base) && canonicalQuantity(effect.quantity_base) === null) fail("QUANTITY_INVALID", "quantity_base");
  if (effect.balance_type === "BATCH" && isBlank(effect.batch_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "batch_id");
  if (effect.balance_type === "HU" && isBlank(effect.hu_id)) fail("REQUEST_INVALID", "hu_id");
  return errors;
}
function validateRequest(request) {
  const errors = [];
  if (!request || typeof request !== "object") return [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: null }];
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.fields) {
    if (f.name === "effects" || f.name === "source_job_id") continue;
    const v = request[f.name];
    if (f.required && isBlank(v)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
    else if (!isBlank(v) && f.max_length && String(v).length > f.max_length) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: f.name });
  }
  if (!isBlank(request.operation_id) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(String(request.operation_id))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "operation_id" });
  if (!isBlank(request.request_hash) && !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(String(request.request_hash))) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_HASH_INVALID", field: "request_hash" });
  if (request.source_job_id === undefined || request.source_job_id === null) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "source_job_id" });
  // Extension field (Task 5): a correction names the operation it corrects and is never that operation itself.
  if (!isBlank(request.original_operation_id)) {
    const orig = String(request.original_operation_id);
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,64}$/.test(orig) || orig === String(request.operation_id)) errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "original_operation_id" });
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(request.effects) || request.effects.length === 0) {
    errors.push({ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" });
    return errors;
  }
  // One operation is one bounded mutation group (request.max_effects, the largest array size proven on the engine).
  // PROVISIONAL engine bound. One operation carries one whole business intent; it is never divided.
  if (request.effects.length > CONTRACT.request.max_effects) {
    return [{ code: "REQUEST_TOO_LARGE", field: "effects", effects: request.effects.length, max_effects: CONTRACT.request.max_effects }];
  }
  const seen = new Set();
  request.effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  return errors;
}
function canonicalEffect(e) {
  const out = {};
  for (const f of CONTRACT.request.effect_fields) {
    const v = e[f.name];
    if (isBlank(v)) continue;
    out[f.name] = f.name === "quantity_base" ? canonicalQuantity(v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}
function computeRequestHash(request) {
  const body = {};
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_fields) {
    if (k === "effects") {
      body.effects = request.effects.map(canonicalEffect).sort((a, b) => cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
    } else {
      body[k] = request[k] === undefined || request[k] === null ? "" : String(request[k]);
    }
  }
  // Extension fields enter the hash only when present, so every hash computed before they existed stays valid.
  for (const k of CONTRACT.request.hash.hashed_when_present) if (!isBlank(request[k])) body[k] = String(request[k]);
  return sha256Hex(canonicalJson(body));
}
function cmp(a, b) {
  const x = a === undefined || a === null ? "" : String(a);
  const y = b === undefined || b === null ? "" : String(b);
  return x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0;
}
function normalizeEffects(effects) {
  if (!Array.isArray(effects) || effects.length === 0) return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", field: "effects" }] };
  const errors = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  effects.forEach((e, i) => {
    errors.push(...validateEffect(e, i));
    if (e && !isBlank(e.effect_key)) {
      if (seen.has(e.effect_key)) errors.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY", field: "effect_key", index: i });
      seen.add(e.effect_key);
    }
  });
  if (errors.length) return { ok: false, errors };

  // The lock row's unique key is case-insensitive (utf8mb4_general_ci): two keys
  // that differ only by case would be one lock row claimed twice by one operation.
  const byUpper = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const u = String(e.balance_key).toUpperCase();
    if (byUpper.has(u) && byUpper.get(u) !== e.balance_key) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "balance_key", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    byUpper.set(u, e.balance_key);
  }

  const uomByKey = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const prev = uomByKey.get(e.balance_key);
    if (prev !== undefined && prev !== e.uom_base) {
      return { ok: false, errors: [{ code: "NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT", field: "uom_base", balance_key: e.balance_key }] };
    }
    uomByKey.set(e.balance_key, e.uom_base);
  }

  const groups = new Map();
  for (const e of effects) {
    const c = canonicalEffect(e);
    const key = canonicalJson(CONTRACT.normalization.group_key.map((k) => (c[k] === undefined ? null : c[k])));
    const g = groups.get(key);
    if (!g) groups.set(key, { base: c, units: quantityUnits(c.quantity_base), keys: [c.effect_key] });
    else {
      g.units += quantityUnits(c.quantity_base);
      g.keys.push(c.effect_key);
    }
  }

  const out = [...groups.values()].map((g) => {
    const keys = [...g.keys].sort(cmp);
    return { ...g.base, effect_key: keys[0], quantity_base: fromUnits(g.units), merged_effect_keys: keys };
  });
  out.sort((a, b) => cmp(a.balance_key, b.balance_key) || cmp(a.stock_status, b.stock_status) || cmp(a.direction, b.direction) || cmp(a.movement_type, b.movement_type) || cmp(a.effect_key, b.effect_key));
  out.forEach((e, i) => {
    e.effect_sequence = i + 1;
  });
  return { ok: true, effects: out, lockKeys: lockOrder(out) };
}
function lockOrder(effects) {
  return [...new Set(effects.map((e) => e.balance_key))].sort(cmp);
}
function gateTaken(op) {
  return !!op && (op.gate_taken === true || (op.gate_taken !== null && op.gate_taken !== undefined && String(op.gate_taken).trim() === "1"));
}
function gateDecision(op) {
  if (!gateTaken(op)) return "";
  const owner = op.gate_owner === undefined || op.gate_owner === null ? "" : String(op.gate_owner).trim();
  if (owner.indexOf("REJECT|") === 0) return "REJECT";
  if (owner.indexOf("APPLY|") === 0) return "APPLY";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}
function gateRejectCode(op) {
  const parts = String(op && op.gate_owner ? op.gate_owner : "").split("|");
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[parts[1]];
  return rc && rc.response_status === "REJECTED" ? parts[1] : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
}
function mutationMayHaveStarted(op) {
  return !!op && (MUTATION_STARTED.includes(op.operation_status) || !isBlank(op.mutation_started_at) || (PRE_MUTATION.includes(op.operation_status) && gateTaken(op) && gateDecision(op) !== "REJECT"));
}
function isUncertain(op) {
  return !!op && op.operation_status !== "DONE" && mutationMayHaveStarted(op);
}
const DB_TIME_RE = /^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(?:\.(\d{1,6}))?$/;
function dbTime(value) {
  const m = typeof value === "string" ? value.match(DB_TIME_RE) : null;
  if (!m) throw new Error(`not a DB column time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS': ${String(value)}`);
  return `${m[1]}.${(m[2] || "").padEnd(6, "0")}`;
}
function leaseExpired(op, now) {
  if (isBlank(op.lease_expires_at)) return true;
  return dbTime(op.lease_expires_at) < dbTime(now);
}
function buildResponse(op, resultCode) {
  const code = resultCode || op.result_code;
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[code];
  if (!rc) throw new Error(`unknown result_code ${code}`);
  const res = {
    operation_id: op.operation_id,
    operation_status: rc.response_status,
    result_code: code,
    effect_summary: op.effect_summary || { effect_count: 0, lock_count: 0, by_status: {}, effects: [] },
  };
  if (rc.response_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW") res.review_reference = op.review_reference || op.operation_id;
  return res;
}
function decideOnRepeat(stored, incoming, now) {
  if (!stored) return { decision: DECISIONS.PROCEED };
  if (stored.request_hash !== incoming.request_hash) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.CONFLICT, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: incoming.operation_id }, "OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT") };
  }
  // DONE first: a completed operation carries mutation_started_at by design.
  if (stored.operation_status === "DONE") {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored, "OK_REPLAYED") };
  }
  if (isUncertain(stored)) {
    // Never proceed. A live MUTATING/VERIFYING run is only waited for; a stale
    // one, an inconsistent row or REQUIRES_REVIEW answers REQUIRES_REVIEW.
    // A pre-mutation row whose APPLY gate was just taken (no mutation_started_at yet) is
    // as live as MUTATING while its lease holds.
    const gateDecided = PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status) && gateTaken(stored) && isBlank(stored.mutation_started_at);
    const running = (["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) || gateDecided) && !leaseExpired(stored, now);
    if (running) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : ["MUTATING", "VERIFYING"].includes(stored.operation_status) ? "STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED" : "OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOT_RETRYABLE, response: buildResponse(stored, code) };
  }
  const rejectGate = gateDecision(stored) === "REJECT";
  const live = !leaseExpired(stored, now);
  if (stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && (!rejectGate || live)) {
    return { decision: DECISIONS.NOOP_RETURN_STORED, response: buildResponse(stored) };
  }
  if (rejectGate) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "REJECTED" && stored.result_code ? stored.result_code : gateRejectCode(stored);
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: true, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id, effect_summary: stored.effect_summary }, code) };
  }
  if (PRE_MUTATION.includes(stored.operation_status)) {
    if (live) return { decision: DECISIONS.IN_PROGRESS, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS") };
    const code = stored.operation_status === "LOCKING" ? "LOCK_CONFLICT" : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
    return { decision: DECISIONS.RECOVER, finish: false, response: buildResponse({ operation_id: stored.operation_id }, code) };
  }
  throw new Error(`unknown operation_status ${stored.operation_status}`);
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishRequest = function publishRequest(guard, pre0, p1, p2, stageRows, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, p2.stepRows), opRows);
  const clean = { headerIds: p2.headerIds, lineIds: p2.lineIds, resIds: p2.resIds, packIds: p2.packIds, hasHeader: p2.hasHeader, hasLines: p2.hasLines, hasRes: p2.hasRes, hasPack: p2.hasPack };
  const fail = (code, why) => Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", code, why, clean), { request: null, requestHash: "", effects: [], effectsJson: "[]", normalizedKeys: [], normalizedQty: {}, call: "NO" });
  const rows = (Array.isArray(stageRows) ? stageRows : stageRows ? [stageRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id) && s(r.line_status) === "VALID" && s(r.effect_key_out));
  rows.sort((a, b) => Number(a.gd_line_index) - Number(b.gd_line_index) || Number(a.allocation_sequence) - Number(b.allocation_sequence));
  const effects = [];
  const resByKey = {};
  for (const r of p2.resRows || []) resByKey[r.job_line_key] = r;
  const extra = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    let ci = null;
    try {
      ci = JSON.parse(r.costing_input);
    } catch (e) {
      ci = null;
    }
    if (!ci) return fail("GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "stage row " + s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence) + " has no costing_input");
    const q = canonicalQuantity(r.base_qty);
    // costing_input carries balance_type / batch_id since D-1 (a stage row of an older job has neither: ITEM)
    const type = s(ci.balance_type) || "ITEM";
    const bx = s(ci.batch_id) ? { batch_id: s(ci.batch_id) } : {};
    effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: s(r.effect_key_out), balance_type: type, balance_key: s(ci.balance_key), direction: "OUT", quantity_base: q, uom_base: s(ci.uom_base), stock_status: s(ci.stock_out), movement_type: s(ci.movement_type), costing_context: ci.costing_context }, bx));
    effects.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: s(r.effect_key_in), balance_type: type, balance_key: s(ci.balance_key), direction: "IN", quantity_base: q, uom_base: s(ci.uom_base), stock_status: s(ci.stock_in), movement_type: s(ci.movement_type), costing_context: ci.costing_context }, bx));
    if (pre.allocationMode === "RESERVE") {
      const res = resByKey[guard.jobId + "|" + s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence)];
      if (!res) return fail("GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "no reservation row for stage row " + s(r.stable_line_key) + "|" + s(r.allocation_sequence));
      // D-4: verify-only - the inventory operation locks RESERVATION|<id> and checks the row this job wrote
      extra.push(Object.assign({ effect_key: s(r.gd_line_index) + "." + s(r.allocation_sequence) + ".RESERVATION.IN", balance_type: "RESERVATION", balance_key: "RESERVATION|" + res.id, direction: "IN", quantity_base: q, uom_base: s(ci.uom_base), movement_type: s(ci.movement_type) }, bx));
    }
  }
  if (sha256Hex(canonicalJson(effects)) !== s(pre.effectsHash)) return fail("GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "the stage rows' effects (" + effects.length + ") do not reproduce the prepared effects_hash");
  // OI4: a delivery numbered on insert was prepared with trx_no "issued"; the movements carry the number the P1
  // read-back found (after the hash check, which covers the prepared text; a resumed run reads the same number, so
  // the request hash is the same)
  if (effects.some((e) => e.costing_context && s(e.costing_context.trx_no) === "issued") && (!s(p1.gdNo) || s(p1.gdNo) === "issued")) return fail("GD_VALIDATION_FAILED", "the delivery number is not known after P1");
  const numbered = (e) => (e.costing_context && s(e.costing_context.trx_no) === "issued" ? Object.assign({}, e, { costing_context: Object.assign({}, e.costing_context, { trx_no: s(p1.gdNo) }) }) : e);
  const all = effects.map(numbered).concat(extra);
  const rq = pre.request || {};
  const req = { operation_id: pre.operationId, request_hash: "", tenant_id: rq.tenant_id, organization_id: rq.organization_id, plant_id: rq.plant_id, source_document_type: rq.source_document_type, source_document_id: p1.gdId, source_job_id: rq.source_job_id, correlation_id: rq.correlation_id, requested_by: rq.requested_by, original_operation_id: "", effects: all };
  req.request_hash = computeRequestHash(req);
  const errs = validateRequest(req);
  if (errs.length) return fail("GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED", "the request would be rejected by the inventory contract: " + canonicalJson(errs.slice(0, 5)));
  const norm = normalizeEffects(all);
  const normalizedQty = {};
  for (const e of norm.ok ? norm.effects : []) normalizedQty[e.effect_key] = e.quantity_base;
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), clean, { request: req, requestHash: req.request_hash, effects: all, effectsJson: JSON.stringify(all), normalizedKeys: Object.keys(normalizedQty).sort(), normalizedQty: normalizedQty, call: "NO" });
};

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.operation_id,
       o.operation_status,
       o.result_code,
       o.review_reference,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.mutation_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS mutation_started_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS lease_expires_at,
       (o.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken,
       g.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner,
       CAST(st.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       st.step_status AS p3_status,
       st.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       st.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN inventory_operation o
    ON o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o.operation_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND g.lock_key = CONCAT('GATE|', '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}')
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step st
    ON st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}'
   AND st.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND st.is_deleted = 0

const RESULT_CODES = CONTRACT.result_codes;

function isBlank(v) {
  return v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() === "");
}
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
function gateTaken(op) {
  return !!op && (op.gate_taken === true || (op.gate_taken !== null && op.gate_taken !== undefined && String(op.gate_taken).trim() === "1"));
}
function gateDecision(op) {
  if (!gateTaken(op)) return "";
  const owner = op.gate_owner === undefined || op.gate_owner === null ? "" : String(op.gate_owner).trim();
  if (owner.indexOf("REJECT|") === 0) return "REJECT";
  if (owner.indexOf("APPLY|") === 0) return "APPLY";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}
function gateRejectCode(op) {
  const parts = String(op && op.gate_owner ? op.gate_owner : "").split("|");
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[parts[1]];
  return rc && rc.response_status === "REJECTED" ? parts[1] : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
}
function mutationMayHaveStarted(op) {
  return !!op && (MUTATION_STARTED.includes(op.operation_status) || !isBlank(op.mutation_started_at) || (PRE_MUTATION.includes(op.operation_status) && gateTaken(op) && gateDecision(op) !== "REJECT"));
}
function isUncertain(op) {
  return !!op && op.operation_status !== "DONE" && mutationMayHaveStarted(op);
}

const dbAddSeconds = function dbAddSeconds(text, seconds) {
  const m = String(text || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return "";
  const t = Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) + seconds * 1000;
  const d = new Date(t);
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n;
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getUTCDate()) + " " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds());
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const mapInventoryResult = function mapInventoryResult(resultCode) {
  const code = String(resultCode || "");
  for (const m of GDC.result_mapping) {
    if (m.result_codes.indexOf(code) < 0) continue;
    if (m.job_error_code === null) return { action: "CONTINUE", error_code: "" };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION") return { action: "RETRY", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS") return { action: "WAIT", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED") return { action: "FAIL_CLEAN", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    return { action: "REVIEW", error_code: m.job_error_code };
  }
  return { action: "REVIEW", error_code: "GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP3 = function publishP3(guard, pre0, p1, p2, opRows, response) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const row = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, list.filter((r) => s(r.p3_id)).map((r) => ({ kind: "STEP", id: r.p3_id, k: "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", v: r.p3_status, n: r.p3_attempt, x: r.p3_op }))), row ? [row] : []);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || pre.dbNow : pre.dbNow;
  const resp = response && typeof response === "object" && s(response.result_code) ? response : null;
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY || { id: "", status: "STARTED", attempt: pre.attempt, opId: pre.operationId };
  const attempt = p3.attempt || pre.attempt || 1;
  const jobBase = Object.assign({}, pre.jobRows[0], { gd_id: p1.gdId, gd_no: p1.gdNo, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 3 });
  const clean = { headerIds: p2.headerIds, lineIds: p2.lineIds, resIds: p2.resIds, packIds: p2.packIds, hasHeader: p2.hasHeader, hasLines: p2.hasLines, hasRes: p2.hasRes, hasPack: p2.hasPack };
  const out = (route, patch) => Object.assign(tailBase(route), clean, { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: "", reviewReference: "", call: "NO" }, patch || {});
  const stepRow = (status, ref, code, msg, opId, att) => ({ id: p3.id, step_status: status, attempt_count: att || attempt, finished_at: status === "STARTED" ? null : dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: ref || "", error_code: code || null, error_message: msg || null });
  const decide = (resultCode, reviewRef, opStatus) => {
    const m = mapInventoryResult(resultCode);
    const details = { review_reference: reviewRef || "", inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: resultCode };
    if (m.action === "CONTINUE") return out("CONTINUE", { resultCode: resultCode, stepDoneRows: p3.id && p3.status !== "DONE" ? [stepRow("DONE", resultCode)] : [], needStepUpd: p3.id && p3.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO", result_message: "inventory " + opStatus + " " + resultCode });
    if (m.action === "WAIT") return out("WAIT", { resultCode: resultCode, jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { error_code: m.error_code, error_message: GDC.codes[m.error_code].message + " (" + pre.operationId + ")", error_details: canonicalJson(details), progress_message: "Publishing Goods Delivery: waiting for inventory", lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(GDC.retry.base_delay_ms / 1000)) })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: m.error_code, result_message: "inventory " + resultCode + ": wait and call again" });
    if (m.action === "RETRY") {
      // the retries used so far: the job's attempt_count, or the P3 row's attempt - 1 when it is ahead (fix round 3,
      // F3: the tail writes the step row before the job row; a death between the two leaves the job one behind, and
      // the P3 row - which carries the operation id of the attempt - is the authority)
      const n = Math.max(Number(jobBase.attempt_count) || 0, (Number(p3.attempt) || 1) - 1);
      if (n + 1 > GDC.retry.max_retries) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", "inventory " + resultCode + " after " + n + " retries", clean, details), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, reviewReference: "", call: "NO" });
      const delayMs = Math.min(GDC.retry.max_delay_ms, GDC.retry.base_delay_ms * Math.pow(2, n));
      const nextId = (pre.organizationId === "0" ? "TEST|GD|" : "GD|") + guard.jobId + "|" + (attempt + 1);
      return out("RETRY", { resultCode: resultCode, nextOperationId: nextId, stepDoneRows: [stepRow("STARTED", resultCode, m.error_code, "attempt " + attempt + " " + resultCode + "; next operation " + nextId, nextId, attempt + 1)], needStepUpd: "YES", jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { attempt_count: n + 1, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(delayMs / 1000)), error_code: m.error_code, error_message: GDC.codes[m.error_code].message + " (" + resultCode + ")", error_details: canonicalJson(details), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: m.error_code, result_message: "inventory " + resultCode + ": retry " + (n + 1) + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + " scheduled with operation " + nextId });
    }
    if (m.action === "FAIL_CLEAN") return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", m.error_code, "inventory REJECTED " + resultCode, clean, details), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, reviewReference: "", call: "NO" });
    return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", m.error_code, "inventory " + opStatus + " " + resultCode, Object.assign({}, details, { review_reference: reviewRef || pre.operationId })), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, call: "NO" }, clean);
  };
  if (pre.stepsDone.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY === "YES" && !resp) return out("CONTINUE", { result_message: "P3 already DONE" });
  if (row) {
    const status = s(row.operation_status);
    const op = { operation_status: status, result_code: s(row.result_code), mutation_started_at: row.mutation_started_at || "", lease_expires_at: row.lease_expires_at || "", gate_taken: row.gate_taken, gate_owner: row.gate_owner };
    const live = String(row.lease_live) === "1";
    if (status === "DONE") return decide(s(row.result_code) || "OK", "", "DONE");
    if (status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW") return decide(s(row.result_code) || "OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW", s(row.review_reference) || pre.operationId, status);
    if (isUncertain(op)) return live ? decide("OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS", "", status) : decide("STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED", pre.operationId, status);
    if (status === "REJECTED") return decide(s(row.result_code) || gateRejectCode(op), "", "REJECTED");
    // A REJECT gate on a row that is not REJECTED yet: a rejecting inventory run stopped between its gate insert and its
    // REJECTED write (it still holds its locks). The gate proves no mutation, but only the inventory workflow finishes
    // the rejection and releases the locks: wait while its lease is live, then call it again (its RECOVER route
    // finishes the REJECT-gated operation); the post-call read then shows REJECTED and the job fails cleanly.
    if (live) return decide("OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS", "", status);
    if (!resp) return out("CALL", { call: "YES", result_message: "operation " + pre.operationId + " is " + status + " with an expired lease: call again (the inventory workflow recovers it)" });
  }
  if (resp) return decide(s(resp.result_code), s(resp.review_reference), s(resp.operation_status));
  return out("CALL", { call: "YES", result_message: "operation " + pre.operationId + " absent: call" });
};

console.log("publish P3 stored", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, op: res.operationId, result: res.resultCode, message: res.result_message }));
return res;

######## sql_node_Iof1pODg [sql-node] P3 facts after the call: the operation row (the stored row is the truth; the response only names codes that store no row)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       o.operation_id,
       o.operation_status,
       o.result_code,
       o.review_reference,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.mutation_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS mutation_started_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(o.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS lease_expires_at,
       (o.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS gate_taken,
       g.owner_operation_id AS gate_owner,
       CAST(st.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       st.step_status AS p3_status,
       st.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       st.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN inventory_operation o
    ON o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o.operation_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND g.lock_key = CONCAT('GATE|', '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}')
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step st
    ON st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}'
   AND st.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND st.is_deleted = 0
