######## code_node_7NQFbpmU [code-node] P3 decision (after the call): stored row + response -> continue / retry / clean failure / review / wait
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P3 decision (after call): the stored operation row + this run's response -> continue / retry / clean failure / review / wait
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {"result_codes":{"OK":{"response_status":"DONE","stage":"complete","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"All effects verified"},"OK_REPLAYED":{"response_status":"DONE","stage":"repeat","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Stored result of a completed operation; nothing written"},"REQUEST_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Missing or malformed identifier or field"},"QUANTITY_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"quantity_base is not a strictly positive decimal with at most 8 fractional digits"},"DIRECTION_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"direction is not IN or OUT"},"BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"balance_type is not ITEM, BATCH, HU or RESERVATION, or balance_key does not start with it"},"DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"effect_key repeated within the operation"},"NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"normalize","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"One balance_key carries two different uom_base values, or two balance_keys differ only by case"},"PERMISSION_DENIED":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Caller may not operate on this tenant, organization or plant"},"REQUEST_TOO_LARGE":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"The request carries more effects than request.max_effects (20,000: the largest read proven on the engine, F46; writes are batched in slices of 250 rows). Nothing was read or written. The intent must not be divided over several operations (open item O4)"},"REQUEST_HASH_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"validate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"request_hash is malformed or does not match the payload"},"OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"create_or_read","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"operation_id already used with another request_hash; stored operation unchanged"},"OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"create_or_read","caller_may_retry":"SAME_OPERATION_LATER","message":"The operation exists and is not terminal; this call made no change. Re-read inventory_operation; do not call again while it is non-terminal."},"LOCK_CONFLICT":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"lock","caller_may_retry":"NEW_OPERATION_ID","message":"A balance key is owned by another operation; nothing mutated"},"BALANCE_STATE_INVALID":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"revalidate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Balance row missing or inconsistent under lock; no mutation"},"STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION":{"response_status":"REJECTED","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NEW_OPERATION_ID","message":"Operation went stale before mutation_started_at; owned locks released; no mutation"},"MUTATION_UNCERTAIN":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"mutate","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Error, timeout or unknown result after mutation_started_at"},"VERIFICATION_MISMATCH":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"verify","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Stored state does not match the expected effect"},"STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"MUTATING or VERIFYING operation went stale"},"OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"repeat","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"Repeat of an operation whose mutation started; nothing written"},"REVIEW_CLOSED":{"response_status":"REQUIRES_REVIEW","stage":"reconcile","caller_may_retry":"NO","message":"The review was closed by an approved reconciliation: every effect is recorded VERIFIED or NOT_APPLIED from stored rows and the locks are released. The operation stays REQUIRES_REVIEW; any correction is a new operation with original_operation_id"}},"operation":{"pre_mutation":["RECEIVED","VALIDATING","LOCKING","LOCKED"],"mutation_started":["MUTATING","VERIFYING","REQUIRES_REVIEW"]}};
const RESULT_CODES = CONTRACT.result_codes;
const PRE_MUTATION = CONTRACT.operation.pre_mutation;
const MUTATION_STARTED = CONTRACT.operation.mutation_started;
function isBlank(v) {
  return v === undefined || v === null || (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() === "");
}
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
function gateTaken(op) {
  return !!op && (op.gate_taken === true || (op.gate_taken !== null && op.gate_taken !== undefined && String(op.gate_taken).trim() === "1"));
}
function gateDecision(op) {
  if (!gateTaken(op)) return "";
  const owner = op.gate_owner === undefined || op.gate_owner === null ? "" : String(op.gate_owner).trim();
  if (owner.indexOf("REJECT|") === 0) return "REJECT";
  if (owner.indexOf("APPLY|") === 0) return "APPLY";
  return "UNKNOWN";
}
function gateRejectCode(op) {
  const parts = String(op && op.gate_owner ? op.gate_owner : "").split("|");
  const rc = RESULT_CODES[parts[1]];
  return rc && rc.response_status === "REJECTED" ? parts[1] : "STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION";
}
function mutationMayHaveStarted(op) {
  return !!op && (MUTATION_STARTED.includes(op.operation_status) || !isBlank(op.mutation_started_at) || (PRE_MUTATION.includes(op.operation_status) && gateTaken(op) && gateDecision(op) !== "REJECT"));
}
function isUncertain(op) {
  return !!op && op.operation_status !== "DONE" && mutationMayHaveStarted(op);
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"result_mapping":[{"result_codes":[],"job_error_code":null},{"result_codes":["OK","OK_REPLAYED"],"job_error_code":null},{"result_codes":["OPERATION_HASH_CONFLICT"],"job_error_code":"GD_INVENTORY_HASH_CONFLICT"},{"result_codes":["OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS"],"job_error_code":"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS"},{"result_codes":["MUTATION_UNCERTAIN","VERIFICATION_MISMATCH","STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED","OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW","REVIEW_CLOSED"],"job_error_code":"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW"},{"result_codes":["LOCK_CONFLICT","STALE_BEFORE_MUTATION"],"job_error_code":"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION"},{"result_codes":["REQUEST_INVALID","REQUEST_TOO_LARGE","QUANTITY_INVALID","DIRECTION_INVALID","BALANCE_TYPE_INVALID","DUPLICATE_EFFECT_KEY","NORMALIZATION_CONFLICT","PERMISSION_DENIED","REQUEST_HASH_INVALID","INSUFFICIENT_STOCK","EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED","BALANCE_STATE_INVALID"],"job_error_code":"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED"}],"retry":{"max_retries":3,"base_delay_ms":2000,"max_delay_ms":30000},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const dbAddSeconds = function dbAddSeconds(text, seconds) {
  const m = String(text || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return "";
  const t = Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) + seconds * 1000;
  const d = new Date(t);
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n;
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getUTCDate()) + " " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds());
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const mutationPossible = function mutationPossible(pre) {
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  if (p3 && p3.status !== "FAILED") return true;
  return !!pre.opStatus && pre.opStatus !== "REJECTED";
};
const opFacts = function opFacts(pre, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const row = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { opStatus: row ? s(row.operation_status) : "" });
};
const failClean = function failClean(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, clean, details) {
  const proven = stepName === "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" && (!pre.opStatus || pre.opStatus === "REJECTED");
  if (!proven && mutationPossible(pre)) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "clean failure refused, the inventory operation may have run: " + why, details), clean || {}, { hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" });
  const st = pre.steps[stepName];
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("FAIL_CLEAN"), clean || {}, {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "FAILED",
    stepDoneRows: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st && st.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: stepName, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: (why || "").slice(0, 500), error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "FAILED", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const mapInventoryResult = function mapInventoryResult(resultCode) {
  const code = String(resultCode || "");
  for (const m of GDC.result_mapping) {
    if (m.result_codes.indexOf(code) < 0) continue;
    if (m.job_error_code === null) return { action: "CONTINUE", error_code: "" };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION") return { action: "RETRY", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS") return { action: "WAIT", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    if (m.job_error_code === "GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED") return { action: "FAIL_CLEAN", error_code: m.job_error_code };
    return { action: "REVIEW", error_code: m.job_error_code };
  }
  return { action: "REVIEW", error_code: "GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP3 = function publishP3(guard, pre0, p1, p2, opRows, response) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const row = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const pre = opFacts(stepsMerge(pre0, list.filter((r) => s(r.p3_id)).map((r) => ({ kind: "STEP", id: r.p3_id, k: "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", v: r.p3_status, n: r.p3_attempt, x: r.p3_op }))), row ? [row] : []);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || pre.dbNow : pre.dbNow;
  const resp = response && typeof response === "object" && s(response.result_code) ? response : null;
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY || { id: "", status: "STARTED", attempt: pre.attempt, opId: pre.operationId };
  const attempt = p3.attempt || pre.attempt || 1;
  const jobBase = Object.assign({}, pre.jobRows[0], { gd_id: p1.gdId, gd_no: p1.gdNo, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 3 });
  const clean = { headerIds: p2.headerIds, lineIds: p2.lineIds, resIds: p2.resIds, packIds: p2.packIds, hasHeader: p2.hasHeader, hasLines: p2.hasLines, hasRes: p2.hasRes, hasPack: p2.hasPack };
  const out = (route, patch) => Object.assign(tailBase(route), clean, { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: "", reviewReference: "", call: "NO" }, patch || {});
  const stepRow = (status, ref, code, msg, opId, att) => ({ id: p3.id, step_status: status, attempt_count: att || attempt, finished_at: status === "STARTED" ? null : dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: ref || "", error_code: code || null, error_message: msg || null });
  const decide = (resultCode, reviewRef, opStatus) => {
    const m = mapInventoryResult(resultCode);
    const details = { review_reference: reviewRef || "", inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: resultCode };
    if (m.action === "CONTINUE") return out("CONTINUE", { resultCode: resultCode, stepDoneRows: p3.id && p3.status !== "DONE" ? [stepRow("DONE", resultCode)] : [], needStepUpd: p3.id && p3.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO", result_message: "inventory " + opStatus + " " + resultCode });
    if (m.action === "WAIT") return out("WAIT", { resultCode: resultCode, jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { error_code: m.error_code, error_message: GDC.codes[m.error_code].message + " (" + pre.operationId + ")", error_details: canonicalJson(details), progress_message: "Publishing Goods Delivery: waiting for inventory", lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(GDC.retry.base_delay_ms / 1000)) })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: m.error_code, result_message: "inventory " + resultCode + ": wait and call again" });
    if (m.action === "RETRY") {
      // the retries used so far: the job's attempt_count, or the P3 row's attempt - 1 when it is ahead (fix round 3,
      // F3: the tail writes the step row before the job row; a death between the two leaves the job one behind, and
      // the P3 row - which carries the operation id of the attempt - is the authority)
      const n = Math.max(Number(jobBase.attempt_count) || 0, (Number(p3.attempt) || 1) - 1);
      if (n + 1 > GDC.retry.max_retries) return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", "inventory " + resultCode + " after " + n + " retries", clean, details), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, reviewReference: "", call: "NO" });
      const delayMs = Math.min(GDC.retry.max_delay_ms, GDC.retry.base_delay_ms * Math.pow(2, n));
      const nextId = (pre.organizationId === "0" ? "TEST|GD|" : "GD|") + guard.jobId + "|" + (attempt + 1);
      return out("RETRY", { resultCode: resultCode, nextOperationId: nextId, stepDoneRows: [stepRow("STARTED", resultCode, m.error_code, "attempt " + attempt + " " + resultCode + "; next operation " + nextId, nextId, attempt + 1)], needStepUpd: "YES", jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { attempt_count: n + 1, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(delayMs / 1000)), error_code: m.error_code, error_message: GDC.codes[m.error_code].message + " (" + resultCode + ")", error_details: canonicalJson(details), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: m.error_code, result_message: "inventory " + resultCode + ": retry " + (n + 1) + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + " scheduled with operation " + nextId });
    }
    if (m.action === "FAIL_CLEAN") return Object.assign(failClean(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", m.error_code, "inventory REJECTED " + resultCode, clean, details), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, reviewReference: "", call: "NO" });
    return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", m.error_code, "inventory " + opStatus + " " + resultCode, Object.assign({}, details, { review_reference: reviewRef || pre.operationId })), { dbNow: dbNow, operationId: pre.operationId, resultCode: resultCode, call: "NO" }, clean);
  };
  if (pre.stepsDone.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY === "YES" && !resp) return out("CONTINUE", { result_message: "P3 already DONE" });
  if (row) {
    const status = s(row.operation_status);
    const op = { operation_status: status, result_code: s(row.result_code), mutation_started_at: row.mutation_started_at || "", lease_expires_at: row.lease_expires_at || "", gate_taken: row.gate_taken, gate_owner: row.gate_owner };
    const live = String(row.lease_live) === "1";
    if (status === "DONE") return decide(s(row.result_code) || "OK", "", "DONE");
    if (status === "REQUIRES_REVIEW") return decide(s(row.result_code) || "OPERATION_UNDER_REVIEW", s(row.review_reference) || pre.operationId, status);
    if (isUncertain(op)) return live ? decide("OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS", "", status) : decide("STALE_AFTER_MUTATION_STARTED", pre.operationId, status);
    if (status === "REJECTED") return decide(s(row.result_code) || gateRejectCode(op), "", "REJECTED");
    // A REJECT gate on a row that is not REJECTED yet: a rejecting inventory run stopped between its gate insert and its
    // REJECTED write (it still holds its locks). The gate proves no mutation, but only the inventory workflow finishes
    // the rejection and releases the locks: wait while its lease is live, then call it again (its RECOVER route
    // finishes the REJECT-gated operation); the post-call read then shows REJECTED and the job fails cleanly.
    if (live) return decide("OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS", "", status);
    if (!resp) return out("CALL", { call: "YES", result_message: "operation " + pre.operationId + " is " + status + " with an expired lease: call again (the inventory workflow recovers it)" });
  }
  if (resp) return decide(s(resp.result_code), s(resp.review_reference), s(resp.operation_status));
  return out("CALL", { call: "YES", result_message: "operation " + pre.operationId + " absent: call" });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const p1 = [{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data}}][0];
const p2 = [{{node:code_node_HGbnLhvZ.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_a4HIjyaU.data.tail}}][0], { dbNow: "", operationId: "", resultCode: "", reviewReference: "", call: "NO", nextOperationId: "" }, () => publishP3(guard, pre, p1, p2, [{{node:sql_node_Iof1pODg.data}}][0], [{{node:code_node_rhoiDSOp.data}}][0]));
console.log("publish P3 after call", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, op: res.operationId, result: res.resultCode, message: res.result_message }));
return res;

  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GD' AS kind, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, '' AS x, '' AS y, CAST(g.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}')
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OP' AS kind, CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(o.operation_id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(o.operation_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, CAST(o.result_code AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(o.review_reference AS CHAR) AS y, CAST(o.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM inventory_operation o
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'
   AND o.operation_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.operationId}}'

       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner

  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'

######## code_node_UPoC0nTI [code-node] Job lease renewal (AFTER_P3_CALL): still COMMITTING_GD under this run's lease -> lease_expires_at = NOW + 10 min
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - job lease renewal jr3 (AFTER_P3_CALL): the job lease = NOW + 10 min while this run holds it (a chain node: nothing after a decided ending)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;

const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const publishJobLease = function publishJobLease(guard, rows, stage) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const r = list[0] || {};
  if (!s(r.db_now) || !s(r.lease_until)) throw new Error("GD_PUBLISH_READ: the lease read returned no DB time");
  const ours = s(r.id) !== "" && s(r.id) === s(guard.jobId) && s(r.lease_owner) === s(guard.leaseOwner) && s(r.lease_owner) !== "";
  const renew = ours && s(r.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), {
    stage: String(stage),
    dbNow: s(r.db_now),
    leaseUntil: s(r.lease_until),
    needLease: renew ? "YES" : "NO",
    leaseRows: renew ? [{ id: s(r.id), lease_expires_at: s(r.lease_until) }] : [],
    why: renew ? "job lease renewed until " + s(r.lease_until) : !s(r.id) ? "no job row" : !ours ? "the job's lease owner is " + (s(r.lease_owner) || "(none)") + ", not this run" : "job is " + s(r.job_status) + ": nothing to renew",
  });
};

console.log("job lease jr3", JSON.stringify({ stage: res.stage, renew: res.needLease, until: res.leaseUntil, why: res.why }));
return res;

######## code_node_DEj4DPIt [code-node] P6 publication barrier -> P6 DONE, the BLOCKED event row, the P7A row
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P6 publication barrier: inventory DONE, every effect VERIFIED, the structure as planned -> P6 DONE, the BLOCKED event, the P7A row
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;

const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
function sha256Hex(text) {
  const s = String(text);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
      const d = i + 1 < s.length ? s.charCodeAt(i + 1) : 0;
      if (d >= 0xdc00 && d <= 0xdfff) {
        c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (d - 0xdc00);
        i++;
      } else c = 0xfffd;
    } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff) c = 0xfffd;
    if (c < 0x80) bytes.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) bytes.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else if (c < 0x10000) bytes.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else bytes.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
  }
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  const lo = bitLen >>> 0;
  bytes.push((hi >>> 24) & 255, (hi >>> 16) & 255, (hi >>> 8) & 255, hi & 255, (lo >>> 24) & 255, (lo >>> 16) & 255, (lo >>> 8) & 255, lo & 255);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const W = new Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += 64) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = ((bytes[off + 4 * t] << 24) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 1] << 16) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 2] << 8) | bytes[off + 4 * t + 3]) >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(W[t - 15], 7) ^ rotr(W[t - 15], 18) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(W[t - 2], 17) ^ rotr(W[t - 2], 19) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const mj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + mj) >>> 0;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
    H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
    H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
    H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
    H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
    H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
    H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
  }
  return H.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
}
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"gd_hidden":"Processing","gd_published":"Created","so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION","event_type":"GD_COMMITTED"};
const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP6 = function publishP6(guard, pre0, p1, req, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const op = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "OP" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const effRows = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "EFF" && s(r.id));
  const eff = {};
  for (const r of effRows) eff[s(r.v)] = (eff[s(r.v)] || 0) + 1;
  const wantKeys = (req && req.normalizedKeys) || [];
  const wantQty = (req && req.normalizedQty) || {};
  const haveKeys = effRows.map((r) => s(r.k)).sort();
  const gd = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const lines = Number((list.filter((r) => r.kind === "LINES")[0] || {}).n) || 0;
  const res = Number((list.filter((r) => r.kind === "RES")[0] || {}).n) || 0;
  const outbox = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "OUTBOX" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const packs = Number((list.filter((r) => r.kind === "PACK")[0] || {}).n) || 0;
  const problems = [];
  if (!op) problems.push("inventory operation " + pre.operationId + " not found");
  else if (s(op.v) !== "DONE") problems.push("inventory operation is " + s(op.v) + " " + s(op.x));
  const total = effRows.length;
  if (canonicalJson(haveKeys) !== canonicalJson(wantKeys)) problems.push("effect keys " + canonicalJson(haveKeys) + " <> normalized request " + canonicalJson(wantKeys));
  const D = dec8();
  for (const r of effRows) if (wantQty[s(r.k)] !== undefined && !D.same(r.n, wantQty[s(r.k)])) problems.push("effect " + s(r.k) + " quantity " + s(r.n) + " <> " + wantQty[s(r.k)]);
  if ((eff.VERIFIED || 0) !== total) problems.push("effects not all VERIFIED: " + canonicalJson(eff));
  if (!gd) problems.push("hidden header missing");
  else if ([GDC.gd_hidden, GDC.gd_published].indexOf(s(gd.v)) < 0) problems.push("header is " + s(gd.v));
  if (lines !== pre.plannedLineCount) problems.push("lines " + lines + " <> " + pre.plannedLineCount);
  if (res !== (pre.resKeys || []).length) problems.push("reservation rows " + res + " <> " + (pre.resKeys || []).length);
  if (packs !== ((pre.packing || {}).required ? 1 : 0)) problems.push("packing shells " + packs + " <> " + ((pre.packing || {}).required ? 1 : 0));
  if (outbox && s(outbox.k) !== p1.eventId) problems.push("outbox row of this job carries event " + s(outbox.k));
  const empty = { outboxRows: [], needOutbox: "NO", stepP7ARows: [], needStepP7A: "NO", eventId: p1.eventId, gdStatus: gd ? s(gd.v) : "", outboxStatus: outbox ? s(outbox.v) : "" };
  if (problems.length) return Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P6_PUBLICATION_BARRIER", "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", "publication barrier: " + problems.slice(0, 5).join("; "), { inventory_result_code: op ? s(op.x) : "", problems: problems }), empty);
  const st6 = pre.steps.P6_PUBLICATION_BARRIER;
  const ev = pre.eventInfo || {};
  const payload = { gdId: p1.gdId, gdNo: p1.gdNo, jobId: guard.jobId, organizationId: pre.organizationId, plantId: pre.plantId, pickingRequired: !!ev.picking_required, sourceSoIds: ev.source_so_ids || [], lineCount: ev.line_count };
  const outboxRows = outbox ? [] : [{ event_id: p1.eventId, event_type: GDC.event_type, event_version: 1, organization_id: pre.organizationId, plant_id: pre.plantId, aggregate_type: "goods_delivery", aggregate_id: p1.gdId, aggregate_no: p1.gdNo, job_id: guard.jobId, payload_hash: sha256Hex(canonicalJson(payload)), correlation_id: (pre.request || {}).correlation_id, causation_id: guard.jobId, picking_required: ev.picking_required ? 1 : 0, occurred_at: pre.dbNow, payload: canonicalJson(payload), dispatch_status: "BLOCKED", attempt_count: 0, row_version: 0 }];
  const st7a = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED", pre.operationId);
  const p7aDone = pre.stepsDone.P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED === "YES";
  const ref = "effects " + total + " VERIFIED; lines " + lines + "; reservations " + res;
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, {
    stepAddRows: st6 ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: "P6_PUBLICATION_BARRIER", step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: ref, error_code: null, error_message: null }],
    needStepAdd: st6 ? "NO" : "YES",
    stepDoneRows: st6 && st6.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st6.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st6.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: ref, error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [],
    needStepUpd: st6 && st6.status !== "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO",
    outboxRows: outboxRows,
    needOutbox: !p7aDone && outboxRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepP7ARows: p7aDone ? [] : st7a.rows,
    needStepP7A: p7aDone ? "NO" : st7a.need,
  });
};

  FROM gd_outbox ob
 WHERE ob.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND ob.event_id = '{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data.eventId}}'
   AND ob.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GD' AS kind, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, '' AS x, '' AS y, CAST(g.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data.gdId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RESID' AS kind, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(r.job_line_key AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(r.status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, CAST(r.target_gd_id AS CHAR) AS x, '' AS y, CAST(r.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM on_reserved_gd r

   AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data.organizationId}}'

UNION ALL

######## code_node_SlxWSQ0R [code-node] P7A check -> P7A DONE, P7B plan
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P7A check: the BLOCKED event exists for this job -> P7A DONE; P7B plan: Processing -> Created (only while Processing)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"gd_hidden":"Processing","gd_published":"Created","so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION","res_hidden":"Processing","res_published":"Allocated","pack_hidden":"Processing","pack_published":"Created"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP7A = function publishP7A(guard, pre0, p1, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const outbox = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "OUTBOX" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const gd = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const resHidden = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "RESID" && s(r.id) && s(r.v) === GDC.res_hidden);
  const pack = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "PACK" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const empty = { createdRows: [], needCreated: "NO", resFlipRows: [], needResFlip: "NO", packFlipRows: [], needPackFlip: "NO", outboxStatus: outbox ? s(outbox.v) : "", gdStatus: gd ? s(gd.v) : "" };
  const review = (why) => Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED", "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", why, {}), empty);
  if (!outbox) return review("outbox event " + p1.eventId + " was not written");
  if (["BLOCKED", "READY", "CLAIMED", "DONE"].indexOf(s(outbox.v)) < 0) return review("outbox event is " + s(outbox.v));
  if (s(outbox.k) !== guard.jobId) return review("outbox event belongs to job " + s(outbox.k));
  if (!gd) return review("hidden header missing");
  const gdStatus = s(gd.v);
  if ([GDC.gd_hidden, GDC.gd_published].indexOf(gdStatus) < 0) return review("header is " + gdStatus);
  const st = pre.steps.P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED;
  const stepDoneRows = st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: p1.eventId, error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
  const st7b = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P7B_GD_CREATED", pre.operationId);
  const p7bDone = pre.stepsDone.P7B_GD_CREATED === "YES";
  const flip = gdStatus === GDC.gd_hidden;
  const resFlipRows = resHidden.map((r) => ({ id: s(r.id), status: GDC.res_published }));
  const packFlipRows = pack && s(pack.v) === GDC.pack_hidden ? [{ id: s(pack.id), packing_status: GDC.pack_published }] : [];
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { stepDoneRows: stepDoneRows, needStepUpd: stepDoneRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: p7bDone ? [] : st7b.rows, needStepAdd: p7bDone ? "NO" : st7b.need, createdRows: flip ? [{ id: p1.gdId, gd_status: GDC.gd_published }] : [], needCreated: flip ? "YES" : "NO", resFlipRows: resFlipRows, needResFlip: resFlipRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", packFlipRows: packFlipRows, needPackFlip: packFlipRows.length ? "YES" : "NO" });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const p1 = [{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_DEj4DPIt.data.tail}}][0], { createdRows: [], needCreated: "NO", resFlipRows: [], needResFlip: "NO", packFlipRows: [], needPackFlip: "NO", outboxStatus: "", gdStatus: "" }, () => publishP7A(guard, pre, p1, [{{node:sql_node_JGbmcdtD.data}}][0]));

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner

  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}

function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const publishJobLease = function publishJobLease(guard, rows, stage) {

  const r = list[0] || {};
  if (!s(r.db_now) || !s(r.lease_until)) throw new Error("GD_PUBLISH_READ: the lease read returned no DB time");
  const ours = s(r.id) !== "" && s(r.id) === s(guard.jobId) && s(r.lease_owner) === s(guard.leaseOwner) && s(r.lease_owner) !== "";
  const renew = ours && s(r.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), {
    stage: String(stage),
    dbNow: s(r.db_now),
    leaseUntil: s(r.lease_until),
    needLease: renew ? "YES" : "NO",
    leaseRows: renew ? [{ id: s(r.id), lease_expires_at: s(r.lease_until) }] : [],
    why: renew ? "job lease renewed until " + s(r.lease_until) : !s(r.id) ? "no job row" : !ours ? "the job's lease owner is " + (s(r.lease_owner) || "(none)") + ", not this run" : "job is " + s(r.job_status) + ": nothing to renew",
  });
};

const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - batch pick of resFlip: rows [index * 250, + 250) of p7a.resFlipRows
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
const writeBatchPick = function writeBatchPick(rows, indexRaw, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const index = indexRaw === undefined || indexRaw === null || indexRaw === "" ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseInt(String(indexRaw), 10) || 0);
  const part = list.slice(index * n, (index + 1) * n);
  return { rows: part, index: index, nextIndex: index + 1, count: part.length, from: index * n };
};

######## code_node_w5PAtzWc [code-node] P7B check -> P7B DONE, P7C plan
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P7B check: the header is Created (point of no return) -> P7B DONE; P7C plan: release the event only while BLOCKED
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"gd_published":"Created","so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION","res_published":"Allocated","pack_published":"Created"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepStartRows = function stepStartRows(guard, pre, name, opId) {
  const ex = pre.steps[name];
  if (ex) return { rows: [], need: "NO" };
  return { rows: [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: opId || "", result_ref: "", error_code: null, error_message: null }], need: "YES" };
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP7B = function publishP7B(guard, pre0, p1, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const gd = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const outbox = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "OUTBOX" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const res = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "RESID" && s(r.id));
  const pack = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "PACK" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const empty = { readyRows: [], needReady: "NO", outboxStatus: outbox ? s(outbox.v) : "", gdStatus: gd ? s(gd.v) : "" };
  const review = (why) => Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P7B_GD_CREATED", "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", why, {}), empty);
  if (!gd) return review("header missing after the Created write");
  if (s(gd.v) !== GDC.gd_published) return review("header is " + s(gd.v) + " after the Created write");
  const notAllocated = res.filter((r) => s(r.v) !== GDC.res_published);
  if (notAllocated.length) return review(notAllocated.length + " reservation rows are not " + GDC.res_published + " after the flip");
  if (res.length !== (pre.resKeys || []).length) return review("reservation rows " + res.length + " <> " + (pre.resKeys || []).length + " after the flip");
  if ((pre.packing || {}).required && (!pack || s(pack.v) !== GDC.pack_published)) return review("packing shell is " + (pack ? s(pack.v) : "missing") + " after the flip");
  if (!outbox) return review("outbox event vanished");
  const st = pre.steps.P7B_GD_CREATED;
  const stepDoneRows = st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: GDC.gd_published, error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
  const st7c = stepStartRows(guard, pre, "P7C_OUTBOX_READY", pre.operationId);
  const p7cDone = pre.stepsDone.P7C_OUTBOX_READY === "YES";
  const release = s(outbox.v) === "BLOCKED";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { stepDoneRows: stepDoneRows, needStepUpd: stepDoneRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: p7cDone ? [] : st7c.rows, needStepAdd: p7cDone ? "NO" : st7c.need, readyRows: release ? [{ id: s(outbox.id), dispatch_status: "READY", next_attempt_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: (Number(outbox.n) || 0) + 1 }] : [], needReady: release ? "YES" : "NO" });
};
