######## code_node_vCoSlH6A [code-node] P7B_SO_PROJECTION plan: before / after values (stored on the step row before the write); on re-entry the rows decide
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P7B_SO_PROJECTION plan: the sales order fulfilment projection of a Created delivery (planned_qty + gd_qty per linked line; header gd_status Created when empty), from the stored plan on re-entry
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishSoPlan = function publishSoPlan(guard, pre0, p1, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const D = dec8();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0");
  const sp = pre.soProjection || { lines: [], so_ids: [] };
  const empty = { lineRows: [], needLines: "NO", headRows: [], needHeads: "NO", plan: null, soStepId: "" };
  const st = pre.steps[GDC.so_step];
  if (!(sp.lines || []).length) return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { result_message: "no sales order projection (no linked lines)", stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: GDC.so_step, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: "no linked sales order lines", error_code: null, error_message: null }], needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES" });
  if (st && st.status === "DONE") return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { soStepId: st.id, result_message: "P7B_SO_PROJECTION already DONE" });
  const sol = {};
  for (const r of list.filter((r) => r.kind === "SOL")) sol[s(r.id)] = r;
  const soh = {};
  for (const r of list.filter((r) => r.kind === "SOH")) soh[s(r.id)] = r;
  const review = (why) => Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, GDC.so_step, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", why, {}), empty, { soStepId: st ? st.id : "" });
  let plan = null;
  if (st) {
    try {
      plan = JSON.parse(st.ref);
    } catch (e) {
      plan = null;
    }
    if (!plan || !plan.lines || !plan.headers) return review("P7B_SO_PROJECTION row carries no readable plan");
  } else {
    const delta = {};
    for (const l of sp.lines) delta[s(l.so_line_id)] = (delta[s(l.so_line_id)] || 0n) + (D.parse(l.delta) || 0n);
    plan = { lines: {}, headers: {} };
    for (const id of Object.keys(delta)) {
      const r = sol[id];
      if (!r) return review("sales order line " + id + " not found for the projection");
      const before = D.parse(r.n) || 0n;
      plan.lines[id] = { before: D.fmt(before), after: D.fmt(before + delta[id]) };
    }
    for (const id of sp.so_ids || []) {
      const h = soh[s(id)];
      if (!h) return review("sales order " + id + " not found for the projection");
      const g = s(h.v);
      plan.headers[s(id)] = { before: g, after: !g || g === "Cancelled" ? "Created" : g };
    }
  }
  const lineRows = [];
  const headRows = [];
  let pending = 0;
  let other = 0;
  for (const id of Object.keys(plan.lines)) {
    const r = sol[id];
    const cur = r && D.parse(r.n) !== null ? String(r.n) : null;
    const L = plan.lines[id];
    if (cur === null) other++;
    else if (D.same(L.before, L.after) || D.same(cur, L.after)) continue;
    else if (D.same(cur, L.before)) {
      lineRows.push({ id: id, planned_qty: L.after });
      pending++;
    } else other++;
  }
  for (const id of Object.keys(plan.headers)) {
    const h = soh[id];
    const cur = h ? s(h.v) : null;
    const H = plan.headers[id];
    if (cur === null) other++;
    else if (H.after === H.before || cur === H.after) continue;
    else if (cur === H.before) {
      headRows.push({ id: id, gd_status: H.after });
      pending++;
    } else other++;
  }
  if (other) return review("sales order rows moved since the plan was made (" + other + " rows at neither the before- nor the after-values)");
  if (st && !pending) return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, { plan: plan, soStepId: st.id, stepDoneRows: [{ id: st.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: st.ref, error_code: null, error_message: null }], needStepUpd: "YES", result_message: "sales order projection already written" });
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, {
    plan: plan,
    soStepId: st ? st.id : "",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: GDC.so_step, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: JSON.stringify(plan), error_code: null, error_message: null }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    lineRows: lineRows,
    needLines: lineRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
    headRows: headRows,
    needHeads: headRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
  });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const p1 = [{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_w5PAtzWc.data.tail}}][0], { lineRows: [], needLines: "NO", headRows: [], needHeads: "NO", plan: null, soStepId: "" }, () => publishSoPlan(guard, pre, p1, [{{node:sql_node_Ep8U0a1T.data}}][0]));
console.log("publish SO plan", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, lines: res.lineRows.length, heads: res.headRows.length, stepAdd: res.needStepAdd, result: res.result_message }));
return res;

// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - batch list of soLines (O4 option b): the slices of soPlan.lineRows, <= 250 rows each
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

console.log("batches soLines", JSON.stringify({ count: res.count, total: res.total }));
return res;

######## code_node_EdveBZL9 [code-node] P7B_SO_PROJECTION check -> DONE
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P7B_SO_PROJECTION check: every sales order row at its planned after-value -> DONE
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,

const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const dec8 = function dec8() {
  const S = 100000000n;
  const parse = (v) => {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
    const m = String(v).trim().match(/^(-)?([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]+))?$/);
    if (!m) return null;
    const frac = m[3] || "";
    if (frac.length > 8 && /[1-9]/.test(frac.slice(8))) return null;
    const u = BigInt(m[2]) * S + BigInt((frac.slice(0, 8) + "00000000").slice(0, 8));
    return m[1] ? -u : u;
  };
  const fmt = (u) => {
    const neg = u < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -u : u;
    const f = (a % S).toString().padStart(8, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + (a / S).toString() + (f ? "." + f : "");
  };
  const mul = (a, b) => {
    const p = a * b;
    const neg = p < 0n;
    const q = ((neg ? -p : p) + S / 2n) / S;
    return neg ? -q : q;
  };
  const same = (a, b) => {
    const x = parse(a);
    const y = parse(b);
    return x !== null && y !== null && x === y;
  };
  return { S: S, parse: parse, fmt: fmt, mul: mul, same: same };
};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishSoCheck = function publishSoCheck(guard, pre0, p1, plan0, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const D = dec8();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0");
  const plan = plan0 && plan0.plan ? plan0.plan : null;
  const st = pre.steps[GDC.so_step];
  if (!plan) return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { result_message: "no sales order projection" });
  if (st && st.status === "DONE") return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { result_message: "P7B_SO_PROJECTION already DONE" });
  const review = (why) => reviewOut(guard, pre, GDC.so_step, "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", why, {});
  if (!st) return review("P7B_SO_PROJECTION row missing after its insert");
  const sol = {};
  for (const r of list.filter((r) => r.kind === "SOL")) sol[s(r.id)] = r;
  const soh = {};
  for (const r of list.filter((r) => r.kind === "SOH")) soh[s(r.id)] = r;
  const bad = [];
  for (const id of Object.keys(plan.lines)) if (!sol[id] || !D.same(sol[id].n, plan.lines[id].after)) bad.push("line " + id);
  for (const id of Object.keys(plan.headers)) if (!soh[id] || s(soh[id].v) !== plan.headers[id].after) bad.push("order " + id);
  if (bad.length) return review("sales order projection not stored as planned: " + bad.slice(0, 5).join(", "));
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), { stepDoneRows: [{ id: st.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: st.ref, error_code: null, error_message: null }], needStepUpd: "YES" });
};

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.lease_owner
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.jobId}}
   AND j.is_deleted = 0

// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - job lease renewal jr5 (BEFORE_P7C): the job lease = NOW + 10 min while this run holds it (a chain node: nothing after a decided ending)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const publishJobLease = function publishJobLease(guard, rows, stage) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const r = list[0] || {};
  if (!s(r.db_now) || !s(r.lease_until)) throw new Error("GD_PUBLISH_READ: the lease read returned no DB time");
  const ours = s(r.id) !== "" && s(r.id) === s(guard.jobId) && s(r.lease_owner) === s(guard.leaseOwner) && s(r.lease_owner) !== "";
  const renew = ours && s(r.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD";
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), {
    stage: String(stage),
    dbNow: s(r.db_now),
    leaseUntil: s(r.lease_until),
    needLease: renew ? "YES" : "NO",
    leaseRows: renew ? [{ id: s(r.id), lease_expires_at: s(r.lease_until) }] : [],
    why: renew ? "job lease renewed until " + s(r.lease_until) : !s(r.id) ? "no job row" : !ours ? "the job's lease owner is " + (s(r.lease_owner) || "(none)") + ", not this run" : "job is " + s(r.job_status) + ": nothing to renew",
  });
};

######## sql_node_J4lgM5hB [sql-node] Read-back: the event, the header, the reservation rows, the packing shell
SELECT 'OUTBOX' AS kind, CAST(ob.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(ob.job_id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(ob.dispatch_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(ob.row_version AS CHAR) AS n, CAST(ob.payload_hash AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(ob.event_id AS CHAR) AS y, CAST(ob.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM gd_outbox ob
 WHERE ob.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND ob.event_id = '{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data.eventId}}'
   AND ob.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GD' AS kind, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, '' AS x, '' AS y, CAST(g.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data.gdId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RESID' AS kind, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(r.job_line_key AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(r.status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, CAST(r.target_gd_id AS CHAR) AS x, '' AS y, CAST(r.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted
  FROM on_reserved_gd r

SELECT 'PACK' AS kind, CAST(pk.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(pk.idempotency_key AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(pk.packing_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(pk.packing_no AS CHAR) AS n, CAST(pk.gd_id AS CHAR) AS x, '' AS y, CAST(pk.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS deleted

######## code_node_Tbpchorx [code-node] P7C check -> P7C DONE; P7D: job GD_COMMITTED - the last node of the chain: its t* fields are what the tail acts on
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - P7C check: the event is READY -> P7C DONE; P7D: the job GD_COMMITTED (+ gd_committed_at)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"}},"progress":{"QUEUED":0,"VALIDATING":10,"AWAITING_CONFIRMATION":null,"CALCULATING":30,"READY_TO_COMMIT":60,"COMMITTING_GD":70,"RECONCILING_GD":null,"GD_COMMITTED":85,"CREATING_PICKING":90,"PICKING_RETRYING":null,"PICKING_READY":99,"COMPLETED":100,"FAILED":null,"CANCELLED":null,"REQUIRES_REVIEW":null},"display":{"QUEUED":"Queued for processing","VALIDATING":"Validating","AWAITING_CONFIRMATION":"Conditions changed; confirmation needed","CALCULATING":"Checking stock and allocation","READY_TO_COMMIT":"Ready to publish","COMMITTING_GD":"Publishing Goods Delivery","RECONCILING_GD":"GD {gd_no} created; finishing publication","GD_COMMITTED":"GD {gd_no} created","CREATING_PICKING":"GD {gd_no} created; creating Picking","PICKING_RETRYING":"GD {gd_no} created; Picking retrying","PICKING_READY":"GD {gd_no} created; Picking {picking_no} ready","COMPLETED":"GD {gd_no} created; processing complete","FAILED":"Not created; correct the highlighted lines","CANCELLED":"Cancelled before publishing","REQUIRES_REVIEW":"Under review (ref {review_reference}); do not retry"},"gd_published":"Created","so_step":"P7B_SO_PROJECTION"};
const tailBase = function tailBase(route) {
  return { route: route, publish_route: route, result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "COMMITTING_GD", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepDoneRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", headerIds: [], lineIds: [], resIds: [], packIds: [], hasHeader: "NO", hasLines: "NO", hasRes: "NO", hasPack: "NO" };
};
const chainStep = function chainStep(prev, own, compute, final) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  // (T_FIELDS / tKey inlined: this function is pasted into code nodes on its own)
  const F = ["route", "result_code", "result_message", "job_status", "jobRows", "needJobUpd", "stepDoneRows", "needStepUpd", "stepAddRows", "needStepAdd", "headerIds", "lineIds", "resIds", "packIds", "hasHeader", "hasLines", "hasRes", "hasPack"];
  const K = (f) => {
    const c = f.replace(/_([a-z])/g, function (m, x) {
      return x.toUpperCase();
    });
    return "t" + c.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + c.slice(1);
  };
  // the carried decision as one object (`tail`, read by the next check node) and as flat t* fields (read by the
  // tail's switches and write nodes)
  const carry = (t) => {
    const tail = {};
    const o = {};
    // the soft-deletes of the hidden rows belong to a clean failure only: every other ending (review, retry, wait,
    // committed) carries empty id lists whatever the check node put beside its decision
    const del = s(t.route) === "FAIL_CLEAN";
    for (const f of F) {
      tail[f] = t[f] === undefined ? tailBase("CONTINUE")[f] : t[f];
      if (!del && /^(headerIds|lineIds|resIds|packIds)$/.test(f)) tail[f] = [];
      if (!del && /^has/.test(f)) tail[f] = "NO";
      o[K(f)] = tail[f];
    }
    tail.end = s(tail.route) === "CONTINUE" ? "NO" : "YES";
    o.tEnd = tail.end;
    o.tail = tail;
    return o;
  };
  const neutral = Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), own || {});
  if (prev && s(prev.end) === "YES") return Object.assign(neutral, { route: "SKIP", publish_route: "SKIP", result_code: s(prev.result_code), result_message: s(prev.result_message), job_status: s(prev.job_status) }, carry(prev));
  const r = compute();
  const ok = r.route === "CONTINUE" || r.route === "CALL";
  if (ok && !final) return Object.assign({}, r, carry(tailBase("CONTINUE")));
  if (ok) return Object.assign({}, r, { needStepUpd: "NO", needStepAdd: "NO", needJobUpd: "NO" }, carry(Object.assign({}, r, { route: r.publish_route || r.route })));
  return Object.assign(neutral, { route: r.route, publish_route: r.publish_route || r.route, result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: s(r.job_status) }, carry(r));
};
const reviewOut = function reviewOut(guard, pre, stepName, code, why, details) {
  const own = pre.steps[stepName];
  // fix round 2, N1: a review decided when the ended step's row is already DONE (P1 / P2 corrupted after the
  // inventory ran) is recorded on the P3 row - updated when it exists, inserted otherwise - so gd_publish_step
  // alone shows it; the DONE row is never rewritten.
  const onP3 = own && own.status === "DONE";
  const p3 = pre.steps.P3_INVENTORY_APPLY;
  const st = onP3 ? p3 : own;
  const rowName = onP3 ? "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY" : stepName;
  const jobBase = pre.jobRows[0];
  const ref = details && details.review_reference ? details.review_reference : pre.operationId;
  const keepRef = stepName === GDC.so_step;
  const updRow = st ? { id: st.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: st.opId || pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef || (onP3 && st.ref) ? st.ref : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why } : null;
  const needUpd = st && (st.status !== "DONE" || onP3);
  return Object.assign(tailBase("REVIEW"), {
    result_code: code,
    result_message: why,
    job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW",
    reviewReference: ref,
    stepDoneRows: needUpd ? [updRow] : [],
    needStepUpd: needUpd ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: rowName, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: keepRef ? "" : ref, error_code: code, error_message: why }],
    needStepAdd: st ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code).replace("{review_reference}", ref) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(Object.assign({ review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, inventory_result_code: "", step: stepName, why: why }, details || {})), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: pre.dbNow, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 1 })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const stepsMerge = function stepsMerge(pre, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const steps = Object.assign({}, pre.steps);
  for (const r of (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind) === "STEP" && s(r.id) && String(r.deleted === undefined ? "0" : r.deleted) === "0")) steps[s(r.k)] = { id: s(r.id), status: s(r.v), attempt: Number(r.n) || 0, opId: s(r.x), ref: s(r.y) };
  const stepsDone = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(steps)) stepsDone[k] = steps[k].status === "DONE" ? "YES" : "NO";
  return Object.assign({}, pre, { steps: steps, stepsDone: stepsDone });
};
const publishP7C = function publishP7C(guard, pre0, p1, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const pre = stepsMerge(pre0, rows);
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.kind));
  const outbox = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "OUTBOX" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const gd = list.filter((r) => r.kind === "GD" && s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const empty = { outboxStatus: outbox ? s(outbox.v) : "", gdStatus: gd ? s(gd.v) : "" };
  const review = (why) => Object.assign(reviewOut(guard, pre, "P7C_OUTBOX_READY", "GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED", why, {}), empty);
  if (!outbox) return review("outbox event vanished before its release");
  if (["READY", "CLAIMED", "DONE"].indexOf(s(outbox.v)) < 0) return review("outbox event is " + s(outbox.v) + " after its release");
  if (!gd || s(gd.v) !== GDC.gd_published) return review("header is not Created at P7C");
  const st = pre.steps.P7C_OUTBOX_READY;
  const stepDoneRows = st && st.status !== "DONE" ? [{ id: st.id, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: st.attempt || 1, finished_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: s(outbox.v), error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
  const st7d = pre.steps.P7D_JOB_COMMITTED;
  const jobBase = Object.assign({}, pre.jobRows[0], { gd_id: p1.gdId, gd_no: p1.gdNo, row_version: pre.rowVersion + 6 });
  return Object.assign(tailBase("CONTINUE"), empty, {
    publish_route: "GD_COMMITTED",
    result_message: "GD " + p1.gdNo + " created",
    job_status: "GD_COMMITTED",
    stepDoneRows: stepDoneRows,
    needStepUpd: stepDoneRows.length ? "YES" : "NO",
    stepAddRows: st7d ? [] : [{ job_id: guard.jobId, organization_id: pre.organizationId, step_name: "P7D_JOB_COMMITTED", step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: 1, started_at: pre.dbNow, inventory_operation_id: pre.operationId, result_ref: p1.gdId, error_code: null, error_message: null }],
    needStepAdd: st7d ? "NO" : "YES",
    jobRows: [Object.assign({}, jobBase, { job_status: "GD_COMMITTED", progress_percent: Math.max(Number(jobBase.progress_percent) || 0, GDC.progress.GD_COMMITTED), progress_message: GDC.display.GD_COMMITTED.replace("{gd_no}", p1.gdNo), error_code: null, error_message: null, error_details: null, lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, gd_committed_at: pre.dbNow })],
    needJobUpd: "YES",
  });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0];
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0];
const p1 = [{{node:code_node_3n1ATbZu.data}}][0];
const res = chainStep([{{node:code_node_ZmLG8Rkz.data.tail}}][0], { outboxStatus: "", gdStatus: "" }, () => publishP7C(guard, pre, p1, [{{node:sql_node_J4lgM5hB.data}}][0]), true);
console.log("publish P7C", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, outbox: res.outboxStatus, result: res.result_message }));
return res;

######## code_node_hJ9zLEnS [code-node] Batches of tDelL: one loop pass per <= 250 rows of p7c.tLineIds
// GD_BULK_COMMIT (GD_BULK_PUBLISH_V2) - batch list of tDelL (O4 option b): the slices of p7c.tLineIds, <= 250 rows each
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-bulk.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs (+ scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs,
// scripts/lib/inventory-apply-operation.mjs) - edit there. Every step is recorded in gd_publish_step BEFORE it runs;
// on re-entry each step reads its facts first and never repeats a write whose result is unknown.
const writeBatches = function writeBatches(rows, size) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : [];
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(size)) || 1);
  const batches = [];
  for (let i = 0; i * n < list.length; i++) batches.push({ i: i, from: i * n, to: Math.min(list.length, (i + 1) * n) });
  return { batches: batches, count: batches.length, total: list.length };
};

######## code_node_P7Eplan0 [code-node] P7E_REORDER plan: GD_CREATED reorder signal once per job (after the job is committed)
// GD_BULK_COMMIT - P7E_REORDER plan: the reorder signal of the old save's GD_CREATED (REORDER_SET_REDIS), once per job.
// Runs only after this run committed the job, and never writes a FAILED row: Entry reads any FAILED step as a clean
// failure and would soft-delete a delivery that is already Created. REORDER appends deltas, so a STARTED row is final.
const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
const list = (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : v ? [v] : []).filter((r) => r);
const guard = [{{node:code_node_WaEyJtlE.data}}][0] || {};
const pre = [{{node:code_node_rZGbQJid.data}}][0] || {};
const tRoute = [{{node:code_node_Tbpchorx.data.tRoute}}][0];
const prepRows = list([{{node:sql_node_hSfouTOr.data}}][0]);
const NAME = "P7E_REORDER";
let why = "";
if (s(tRoute) !== "GD_COMMITTED") why = "the job was not committed by this run (" + s(tRoute) + ")";
else if ((pre.steps || {})[NAME]) why = NAME + " already recorded: never repeated";
let p = null;
if (!why) {
  try {
    p = JSON.parse(s((prepRows[0] || {}).prepared_payload));
  } catch (e) {
    p = null;
  }
  if (!p || !Array.isArray(p.lines)) why = "prepared_payload unreadable at P7E";
}
const rows = [];
if (!why) {
  // REORDER reads table_gd rows (temp_qty_data, gd_qty, base_qty); a bundle row is replaced by its items
  for (const top of p.lines) {
    if (!top) continue;
    const isBundle = !!s(top.item_bundle_id) && !s(top.material_id);
    const lineRows = isBundle ? (Array.isArray(top.children) ? top.children : []) : [top];
    for (const r of lineRows) {
      if (!r || !s(r.material_id)) continue;
      rows.push({ material_id: s(r.material_id), gd_qty: s(r.gd_qty), base_qty: s(r.base_qty), temp_qty_data: typeof r.temp_qty_data === "string" ? r.temp_qty_data : JSON.stringify(r.temp_qty_data || []) });
    }
  }
  if (!rows.length) why = "no stock lines";
}
const go = why === "";
const stepAddRows = go ? [{ job_id: s(guard.jobId), organization_id: s(pre.organizationId), step_name: NAME, step_status: "STARTED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: s(pre.dbNow), inventory_operation_id: s(pre.operationId), result_ref: String(rows.length), error_code: null, error_message: null }] : [];
console.log("publish P7E plan", JSON.stringify({ go: go, rows: rows.length, why: why }));
return { publish_route: go ? "CALL" : "SKIP", needP7E: go ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: stepAddRows, latestRows: go ? rows : [], organizationId: s(pre.organizationId), rowCount: String(rows.length), dbNow: s(pre.dbNow), result_message: go ? "GD_CREATED reorder, " + rows.length + " lines" : why };

RESP: ['publish_route', 'needP7E', 'stepAddRows', 'latestRows', 'organizationId', 'rowCount', 'dbNow', 'result_message']
